Episodes.Description: Superman's worst nightmare comes to life and Lois confronts Leslie Larr. Meanwhile, Lana, Kyle and Sarah agree to stay to help General Lane.

Episodes.Title: What Lies Beneath
Episodes.Description: Lois and Clark struggle as a couple while Chrissy adjusts to running The Smallville Gazette with Lois. Jonathan faces new challenges on the football field, and secrets threaten to destroy Jordan and Sarah's growing relationship. Meanwhile, Kyle grows concerned over Lana's involvement with a new mayoral candidate. Lastly, John Henry Irons and his daughter Natalie attempt to make this new Earth their home.

Episodes.Title: The Ties That Bind
Episodes.Description: Clark opens up to Lois about his ongoing struggle with visions and admits that there is only one person who might be able to help. Meanwhile, Lana receives some unexpected news and tensions begin to rise between Lois and Chrissy. Lastly, Sarah breaks plans with Jordan to spend time with Natalie.

Episodes.Title: The Thing in the Mines
Episodes.Description: Lois reaches out to Ret. General Lane as Clark's visions become worse during heated arguments with both Jonathan and Jordan. Meanwhile, Lana shares her frustrations with Kyle. Lastly, Natalie learns that her father didn't follow through on a promise he made to her.

Episodes.Title: The Inverse Method
Episodes.Description: Lois and Chrissy are on a mission to find Lois' sister Lucy and Jonathan and Jordan become more and more unsettled as Clark's painful visions continue. Meanwhile, Lana, Kyle and Sarah share a family breakfast and discuss Sarah's upcoming quinceañera. Lastly, Natalie and her father share a bonding moment.

Episodes.Title: Girl… You'll Be a Woman, Soon
Episodes.Description: Lana, Kyle and Sarah prepare for Sarah's quinceañera, but things don't end up going as smoothly as they had hoped. Clark finds himself struggling with feelings of guilt about what happened to John Irons and Lois worries that she might have been wrong about Ally. Meanwhile, Jonathan learns that Ret. General Samuel Lane is planning to train Jordan. Lastly, Chrissy goes searching for the truth about Lois.

Episodes.Title: Tried and True
Episodes.Description: Lois tells Clark that she and Chrissy plan to do a deeper dive into the Inverse Society and Lana and Sarah try to comfort each other after the fallout at Sarah's quinceañera. Meanwhile, Jordan notices something suspicious in Jonathan's book bag. Lastly, Lt. Mitch Anderson finds himself under fire for the deterioration of the department of defense's relationship with Superman.

Episodes.Title: Anti-Hero
Episodes.Description: Superman pleads with Lt. Anderson to investigate Ally Allston and Lois receives some very upsetting news. Meanwhile, Lois helps Lana prepare to fight the good fight. Lastly, Jordan is still irritated with Jonathan for lying to him.

Episodes.Title: Into Oblivion
Episodes.Description: Lois, Clark, and Natalie notice a difference in John Henry's behavior and fear something might be very wrong. Meanwhile, Kyle encounters an awkward moment with Lana while stopping by the house to pick Sarah up for school. Lastly, Jonathan and Jordan brace themselves when they realize a talking to from their parents is headed their way.

Episodes.Title: 30 Days and 30 Nights
Episodes.Description: Lois thanks Lana for sticking up for Jonathan when one of the football players mother's starts dogging him for getting football season cancelled. Meanwhile, Jordan's unexpected departure on the mayoral election day leaves Sarah rattled. Lastly, Natalie and Sarah wonder if they notice a spark between John Henry and Lana.

Episodes.Title: Bizarros in a Bizarro World
Episodes.Description: Superman races through the portal after Ally Allston, but when he arrives on the other side, he discovers everything on this parallel earth is... bizarre. Navigating his way through deceivingly familiar faces and landscapes, Superman goes on one wild ride in his fight to stop Ally from merging.

Episodes.Title: Truth and Consequences
Episodes.Description: We pick up right where we left off with Jon-El smirking at Lois, who is still standing on the porch with Jordan. Jon-El, catches sight of his doppelganger Jonathan, standing not too far away. He lunges at him and Jordan tries to intervene but Jon-El appears to be stronger and faster than him.

Episodes.Title: Lies That Bind
Episodes.Description: We pick up right where we left off with Clark levitating in front of Lana. Meanwhile, Jordan and Jonathan question whether Lois and Clark are telling them the complete story. Lastly, Natalie tries her best to get Sarah to acknowledge Jordan.

Episodes.Title: All Is Lost
Episodes.Description: Clark and Lois disagree on the best way to figure out if Ally Allston went to the Inverse World. Meanwhile, John Henry makes a surprising discovery and Lois sets out to track Lucy down.

Episodes.Title: Worlds War Bizarre
Episodes.Description: A weary Lois holds vigil at Superman's bedside. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Jordan continue to worry about their father who seems more human now than ever. Lastly, John Henry and Natalie work together to figure out the best way to defend against Ally Allston's powers.

Episodes.Title: Waiting for Superman
Episodes.Description: Chrissy Beppo, with the authorization of the Department of Defense, has a message for the people of Smallville, not only is the merging of planets real, it is happening.

Episodes.Title: Closer
Episodes.Description: Lois' undercover assignment reveals a deadly foe that promises to change the Kent family forever. Meanwhile, the Kent boys find themselves being pulled in opposite directions.

Episodes.Title: Uncontrollable Force
Episodes.Description: Clark and Chrissy both notice a small crack in Lois' game face. Sarah and Jordan have an awkward encounter, and Lana receives a panicked phone call.

Episodes.Title: In Cold Blood
Episodes.Description: Lois and Chrissy pursue a new lead in the Mannheim investigation against Clark's wishes. Meanwhile, Jonathan, Jordan, and Nat face an unexpected obstacle.

Episodes.Title: Too Close to Home
Episodes.Description: Lois interrupts an intense conversation between Clark and John Henry. Meanwhile, Jonathan has a heated discussion with Candice's dad.

Episodes.Title: Head On
Episodes.Description: Clark and General Lane are both having a hard time giving Lois room to make her own decisions. Meanwhile, Lana and Sarah have a run-in with an old friend at the diner.

Episodes.Title: Of Sound Mind
Episodes.Description: Clark finds himself in uncharted territory, and Lois bonds with a new friend. Meanwhile, Superman pays Bruno Mannheim a surprise visit.

Episodes.Title: Forever and Always
Episodes.Description: Lois and Clark dig deeper on Bruno Mannheim, starting with his connections to Hob's Bay Medical Center, while Jonathan and Jordan panic at home over Lois' dire diagnosis.

Episodes.Title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
Episodes.Description: After learning about Bruno and Peia, Clark works to reignite Lois' interest in taking Bruno down; elsewhere, Natalie meets Matteo's parents, with disastrous consequences.

Episodes.Title: The Dress
Episodes.Description: Superman and John Henry clash over how to handle Bruno Mannheim, while Lois worries over upcoming treatments and confides in Lana about her early courtship with Clark.

Episodes.Title: Collision Course
Episodes.Description: Lois attempts to interview Peia in the hopes of unearthing the truth about an old case, while Clark struggles to spend quality time with the boys.

Episodes.Title: Complications
Episodes.Description: Clark helps Lois prepare for a procedure but must leave the boys with her to help John Henry and General Lane track down the Mannheims.

Episodes.Title: Injustice
Episodes.Description: Finally, after seventeen years behind bars, Lex Luthor is set to be released from prison. Lois and Clark clash with Jordan over his carelessness around using his powers in public, while Jonathan struggles with Kyle's change in behavior at the firehouse.

Episodes.Title: What Kills You Only Makes You Stronger
Episodes.Description: All of Smallville comes together to view a meteor shower, and Lex Luthor makes his move to take down Superman and Lois.

Episodes.Title: The End & the Beginning
Episodes.Description: Superman is in a brutal battle with Luthor's monster; Lois and the boys race to save General Lane.

Episodes.Title: A World Without
Episodes.Description: Lana and Sarah join the fight against Luthor; Jordan and Jonathan butt heads over a decision.

Episodes.Title: Always My Hero
Episodes.Description: Reeling from failure, Jordan begins to spiral; Jonathan discovers newfound strength.

Episodes.Title: A Perfectly Good Wedding
Episodes.Description: Lois helps throw Kyle and Chrissy an impromptu wedding that doesn't quite go as planned.

Episodes.Title: Break the Cycle
Episodes.Description: Lois takes bolder actions to stop Luthor; Jonathan juggles personal life and responsibilities; Clark discovers an unsettling truth.

Episodes.Title: When the Lights Come On
Episodes.Description: Luthor plans to move LuthorCorp to Smallville, but finds opposition in Lana.

Episodes.Title: A Regular Guy
Episodes.Description: After some concerning interactions in town, Clark is determined to protect the secret that he's Superman – a task complicated by Jonathan and Jordan.

Episodes.Title: Sharp Dressed Man
Episodes.Description: Luthor challenges Lois to a live telecast debate, though not everything is as it seems; John Henry and Clark face a troubling possibility.

Episodes.Title: To Live and Die Again
Episodes.Description: Lois struggles against the fallout of the debate. Clark uses Luthor's tactics against him, while Jonathan and Jordan prepare for an impending battle.

Episodes.Title: It Went By So Fast
Episodes.Description: The Kents fight with everything they have as Luthor makes his final move on Smallville.

Entries.Title: Ragnarok
Entries.Description: Returning to his family’s hometown, awkward teenager Magne discovers his strange new powers. Still, the hamlet's natural beauty cloaks dark secrets.

Episodes.Title: New Boy
Episodes.Description: Returning to his family’s hometown, awkward teenager Magne discovers his strange new powers. Still, the hamlet's natural beauty cloaks dark secrets.

Episodes.Title: 541 Meters
Episodes.Description: Magne and his classmates try to regroup after a tragic loss, while the police seem uninterested in getting to the truth. Gry stumbles on Vidar unmasked.

Episodes.Title: Jutulheim
Episodes.Description: The break-in confirms what Magne suspects: He must take matters into his own hands. After tying up loose ends, the Jutuls put the teen to the test.

Episodes.Title: Ginnungagap
Episodes.Description: A search for answers brings Magne back to a mysterious woman — and a meaningful mountain. Turid confronts Ran, and former BFFs Gry and Saxa get heated.

Episodes.Title: Atomic Number 48
Episodes.Description: As Fjor holds Vidar back, Magne takes the blame, then tries a new tack. Threats abound, and the greatest is the explosive find that Isolde left behind.

Episodes.Title: Yes, We Love This Country
Episodes.Description: While attempting to expose the truth, Magne gets another shock. Hope seems lost, but have the Jutuls underestimated their foe — and the power of good?

Episodes.Title: Brothers in Arms
Episodes.Description: A battle ends with a bang — and an ominous promise of violence. After visiting another realm, Magne hunts for allies while Vidar marshals his forces.

Episodes.Title: What Happened to the Nice, Old Lady?
Episodes.Description: The truth hurts, and a fight for hearts and minds kicks off. Vidar gets under Magne's skin, Iman feels her power, and Laurits discovers his dark side.

Episodes.Title: Power to the People
Episodes.Description: Edda rises: Magne confronts Ran, and Laurits proves a point. As protests gather momentum, a king walks again, and a master manipulator gets played.

Episodes.Title: God Is God, Though All Men Death Had Tasted
Episodes.Description: A patriarch passes — and a strange new creature is born. Magne tries to change, Laurits lashes out and Fjor charts a new path. Saxa and Iman step up.

Episodes.Title: Know Yourself
Episodes.Description: In a seismic shift, Magne rejects strength, Fjor makes a power grab and a circle closes ranks. Laurits learns the truth, and Iman reaches out to Ran.

Episodes.Title: All You Need Is Love
Episodes.Description: Desperate times fire up Magne and his crew as they go on a risky mission. The Jutuls face an unforeseen enemy while a formidable ancient force awakens.

Episodes.Title: War Is Over
Episodes.Description: Bereft of his hammer, Magne continues to battle the Giants while complying with modern rules. But when he breaks a pact, the truce crumbles.

Episodes.Title: Till Death Do Us Part
Episodes.Description: The Jutuls decide to play along with Magne's antics to make him more open to Saxa's plan. Feeling rejected by everyone, Laurits finds support in Jens.

Episodes.Title: Losing My Religion
Episodes.Description: Under Saxa's spell, Magne continues to fall further from himself — a perfect distraction for Fjor to enact his vicious plan and set a dangerous trap.

Episodes.Title: My Precious
Episodes.Description: More vulnerable than ever, Magne requires backup to face his relentless foes. An impossible ultimatum threatens Laurits' loved ones.

Episodes.Title: A Farewell to Arms
Episodes.Description: As Magne's arrogance sows discord among his allies, the gods stand at a crossroads between forging lasting peace or fighting the impending battle.

Episodes.Title: Ragnarok
Episodes.Description: Despite Edda's embrace of a new dawn, the young God of Thunder cannot evade the predestined future that awaits.

Entries.Title: The New Adventures of Superman
Entries.Description: An alien ship uses an energy creature to attack Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Force Phantom
Episodes.Description: An alien ship uses an energy creature to attack Earth.

Episodes.Title: Mermen Of Emor
Episodes.Description: Scuba divers are captured for sport by malevolent fish beings led by Triton.

Episodes.Title: The Prehistoric Pterodactyls
Episodes.Description: Two giant flying monsters are freed from frozen suspension.

Episodes.Title: Merlin's Magic Marbles
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor uses a temporal communicator to discover magic powers.

Episodes.Title: The Threat of the Thrutans
Episodes.Description: An alien space probe trapped in Earth orbit uses force to try to return to its home galaxy.

Episodes.Title: The Wicked Warlock
Episodes.Description: A male witch called the Warlock must seize a rare gem that contains powerful magic.

Episodes.Title: The Chimp Who Made It Big
Episodes.Description: The fusion of two irradiated pieces of space debris fatefully changes a chimpanzee named Toto on board a space craft.

Episodes.Title: The Deadly Icebergs
Episodes.Description: Saboteurs have rigged gigantic icebergs with explosives to rob a luxury liner.

Episodes.Title: Robot of Riga
Episodes.Description: Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen are kidnapped by alien hunters whose "zoo" is protected by a giant robot.

Episodes.Title: The Invisible Raiders
Episodes.Description: The Sorcerer, a malevolent wizard, uses hirelings using an invisibility field to commit crimes.

Episodes.Title: Neolithic Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Jimmy Olsen falls into an underground pocket populated by malevolent creatures.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Brainiac
Episodes.Description: An alien computer named Brainiac has been capturing different kinds of animals by shrinking them.

Episodes.Title: The Magnetic Monster
Episodes.Description: A magnetic device that melts metal objects is used by alien beings on Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Toys of Doom
Episodes.Description: Phoning in an anonymous tip to lure Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen to an abandoned factory on the outskirts of Metropolis, Toyman captures Lois and Jimmy to help launch a wave of crime and keep Superman away.

Episodes.Title: The Iron Eater
Episodes.Description: A shapeshifting alien creature that emerged from a fallen meteorite who devours metal structures raises havoc.

Episodes.Title: The Ape Army of the Amazon
Episodes.Description: In South America, an exiled military officer named Colonel Vasta and a disgraced scientist named Dr. Rucas control apes with the transmitter on Dr. Rucas' back in a plot to rob an underground treasure.

Episodes.Title: The Fire Phantom
Episodes.Description: A living flame from Earth's core appears and sets off a mammoth forest fire.

Episodes.Title: The Deadly Dish
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor traps Lois, Jimmy, and Perry White so he can lure Superman into range of a Kryptonite Transmitter.

Episodes.Title: Insect Raiders
Episodes.Description: Criminals who have perfected insect powers must stop Superman from foiling their wave of crime.

Episodes.Title: Return of Warlock
Episodes.Description: The Warlock steals a magic gem to wreak havoc on Superman's friends.

Episodes.Title: The Abominable Ice-Man
Episodes.Description: An ice being freezes tropical Hawaii where Lois Lane is having her vacation.

Episodes.Title: The Men from A.P.E.
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor, The Warlock, Toyman, and Prankster form the organization A.P.E. (short of Allied Perpetrators of Evil) and combine their powers to defeat Superman.

Episodes.Title: The Tree Man of Arbora
Episodes.Description: A tree being brought to life near a meteor crater consumes enormous quantities of water.

Episodes.Title: The Image Maker
Episodes.Description: A master criminal scientist named Luna (AKA Professor Leo Nula) captures Lois in order to send her into space within his 4D movie as part of his revenge on her for sending him to prison seven years ago.

Episodes.Title: Superman's Double Trouble
Episodes.Description: A mid-ocean earthquake releases a giant lobster and a giant alligator.

Episodes.Title: The Deadly Super-Doll
Episodes.Description: The Sorcerer uses a voodoo doll to stop Superman.

Episodes.Title: Lava Men
Episodes.Description: In Mexico, a volcano creates living beings of lava.

Episodes.Title: Luthor Strikes Again
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor uses Jimmy Olsen as bait to use Kryptonite laser beam weapons against Superman in a paint factory.

Episodes.Title: Mission to Planet Peril
Episodes.Description: Alien raiders forced to Earth recruit Superman to rescue hostages on their home world.

Episodes.Title: The Pernicious Parasite
Episodes.Description: While breaking into a science lab, a petty criminal named I.C. Harris is exposed to a radioactive isotope and achieves power to drain physical strength from other men.

Episodes.Title: The Two Faces of Superman
Episodes.Description: Toyman creates a robot doppelganger of The Man Of Steel.

Episodes.Title: The Imp-Practical Joker
Episodes.Description: A carnival is raided by an extra-dimensional prankster known as Mister Mxyzptlk.

Episodes.Title: Superman Meets Brainiac
Episodes.Description: Brainiac raids Earth to gather creatures to repopulate a planet devastated by atomic wars.

Episodes.Title: Seeds of Disaster
Episodes.Description: Alien seed pods grow plants that destroy other objects.

Episodes.Title: The Malevolent Mummy
Episodes.Description: An Egyptian sorcerer in mummified form attacks Lois and Superman.

Episodes.Title: The Bird-Men From Lost Valley
Episodes.Description: Avian beings must raid outside farmlands for survival because a gold raider named Trask and his henchmen hold their populace hostage.

Episodes.Title: A.P.E. Strikes Again
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor, the Warlock, and Brainiac reunite as the Allied Perpetrators of Evil in order to destroy the Trouble Televisor which is a machine that can signal Superman whenever a crime is being committed. Superman must stop the villians before they can get to the machine.

Episodes.Title: The Lethal Lightning Bug
Episodes.Description: When lightning strikes a swamp, a monsterous lightning bug is created that threatens to ruin a nearby space launch. Superman goes to investigate the bug and discovers that it re-energizes itself by going back to the swamp. Superman uses this knowledge to stop the bug before it interferes with the space launch.

Episodes.Title: The Prankster
Episodes.Description: The Prankster annoys Superman when a paper safe drops harmlessly on Clark Kent. Superman wants to send him to jail, but is unable to since he cannot prove that the Prankster is behind any of the pranks . Superman decides to get back at the Prankster by playing pranks on him. The Prankster becomes so annoyed that he confesses to his crimes. Superman gets the confession on tape and the Prankster is taken away.

Episodes.Title: The Saboteurs
Episodes.Description: A group of saboteurs plan to dump atomic waste into Metropolis harbor. When the city is evacuated, they plan to rob the city blind. Superman learns of the plan when Lois and Clark are kidnapped aboard a ship carrying atomic waste. Superman foils the plan and brings the saboteurs to justice.

Episodes.Title: The Wisp of Wickedness
Episodes.Description: When an evil alien is turned into a mist by an experiment, the mist arrives on Earth and settles into the hat of a Metropolis motorist. The hat influences the driver into trying to drive his car into a children's playground. Superman stops the car and grabs the motorist. When the hat blows away, the motorist cannot recall why he tried to drive through the playground. Superman lets him go, but when the hat finds another owner the same inexplicable crime almost happens again. Eventually Superman figures out that the hat is behind the problem.  He notices the alien mist and freezes it. He then sends it into space where it can do no more harm.

Episodes.Title: Superman Meets His Match
Episodes.Description: A Kryptonite meteor falls to Earth and weakens Superman as its falls into the ocean. When the meteor hits the bottom of the ocean it breaks in two and releases a green creature that has the same powers as Superman. Superman cannot defeat the creature but manages to knock it out. He takes the unconscious creature into space and sends it far away from Earth.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Octopod
Episodes.Description: An octopod machine comes out of a flying saucer and threatens a rocket base near Niagara Falls. Superman dumps the octopod into the water and destroys the space ship that brought it to Earth. Unfortunate, an electric eel re-activates the Octopod and it emerges from the water and attacks a nearby power station. Superman comes to the rescue again and dispatches the Octopod once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Brainiac's Bubbles
Episodes.Description: When a UFO comes to Metropolis, it releases a bubble which captures Lois Lane. Superman comes to the rescue, but he too is caught in a bubble. The bubbles are the work of Brainiac. He has been sent to Earth to capture Lois and take her to a planet. Superman, however, puts a stop to the plan. He escapes from the bubble and rescues Lois.

Episodes.Title: War of the Bee Battalion
Episodes.Description: A growth ray is used on a swarm of bees and the bees grow to enormous size. They are sent to attack Metropolis and Superman must find some way to stop them.

Episodes.Title: The Toyman's Super-Toy
Episodes.Description: The Toyman constructs an enormous remote control robot insect. He test flies it over a zoo and scares the animals. When Superman arrives to stop the insect, the Toyman purposely destroys it. He constructs another and gives it the capacity to produce Kryptonite rays out of its eyes. He sends the robot after Superman, but Superman successfully destroys it by using lead to sheild himself from the Kryptonite radiation.

Episodes.Title: The Cage of Glass
Episodes.Description: Braniac shrinks the city of Metropolis to the size of an ant colony using a shrinking ray. He places a sheild around it that Superman cannot break through. Fortunately, Superman escapes through a ventilation tube. He defeats Braniac and returns Metropolis back to its normal size.

Episodes.Title: The Atomic Superman
Episodes.Description: Superman drinks an explosive and discovers that it causes him to breathe fire. Superman heads to the planet Mercury where he begins to live with other fire breathing creatures. Eventually the explosive wears off and Superman returns home.

Episodes.Title: Luthor's Loco Looking Glass
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor develops a matter transfer machine that looks like a mirror. He sends it to the Daily Planet where Jimmy Olsen accidently falls into it. Jimmy is transported to an abandoned amusement park where he is soon surrounded by Lex Luthor's sharks. He alerts Superman using his signal watch. Superman arrives, rescues Jimmy, and captures Lex Luthor.

Episodes.Title: The Warlock's Revenge
Episodes.Description: The Warlock gets out of prison when his sister uses a magic ruby on a broom. The Warlock takes the Ruby and decides to get revenge on Superman. He attacks Lois Lane and conjures a magic creature to defeat Superman. Superman, however, gets the best of the creature and captures the Warlock.

Episodes.Title: The Halyah of the Himalayas
Episodes.Description: In Himalaya Mountains, a plane crash awakens a creature called the Halyah that has been asleep for a hundred years. The creature attacks a number of people before it is stopped by Superman.

Episodes.Title: Luthor's Fatal Fireworks
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor kidnaps Jimmy Olsen and puts him in a hot-air balloon. Luthor shoots fireworks at the balloon in an attempt to alert Superman. When Superman arrives, Lex Luthor shoots at him with fireworks laced with Kryptonite. Superman, however, out thinks Luthor and captures him in the end.

Episodes.Title: Luthor's Lethal Laser (1)
Episodes.Description: Lois and Jimmy are trapped in a rocket by Lex Luthor. They are sent to the moon where Lex Luthor has constructed a secret base. Lex aims an enormous laser at Earth and threatens the leaders of the world. He tells them that if he is not given control of the world, he will melt the ice caps and flood the world's coasts.

Episodes.Title: Luthor's Lethal Laser (2)
Episodes.Description: Superman heads to the moon to stop Luthor's plan to take over the world. He rescues Lois and Jimmy, but Luthor reveals that he is working with Brainiac. The two supervillians try to destroy Superman by shrinking him and exposing him to kryptonite gas. Fortunately, Superman escapes their trap and stops the villians.

Episodes.Title: Can a Luthor Change His Spots? (1)
Episodes.Description: When Lex Luthor turns up at the Daily Planet, he claims to be reformed. He is made science editor by Perry White. Jimmy sneaks into Luthor's laboratory in the Daily Planet and discovers a lightning machine. Luthor claims he built it as a security system for the building. Jimmy, however, continues to distrust Luthor. He becomes even more convinced when he sees Luthor robbing a bank vault and endangering Perry White.

Episodes.Title: Can a Luthor Change His Spots? (2)
Episodes.Description: As Luthor appears to be robbing the bank vault, Superman arrives to stop him. He rescues Perry White, but leaves when Luthor claims he was only involved as part of a demonstration. Jimmy still is not convinced of Luthor's good intentions. He follows Luthor and discovers his real scheme. Luthor wants to launch the Daily Planet building into outer space. Unfortunately, Luthor captures Jimmy and ties him up. Superman must figure out a way of rescuing Jimmy and stopping Lex Luthor before he can launch the building.

Episodes.Title: The Team of Terror (1)
Episodes.Description: An evil alien named Satana arrives on Earth from the planet Quanta. She attempts to steal energy from a nuclear power planet in order to use it to attack her home planet. Superman manages to stop her. Later Satana meets with the Warlock and the two decide to work together. She uses a substance called plasto to make his wand's magic ruby radiate kryptonite rays. The two villians decide to use the wand to destroy Superman.

Episodes.Title: The Team of Terror (2)
Episodes.Description: The Warlock and Satana decide to trap Superman by capturing Lois and Jimmy. When Superman arrives to rescue them, the Warlock attacks Superman with Kryptonite rays. Superman, however, manages to stop the Warlock. He, then, turns his attention to Satana. Satana creates an army of monsters to attack him. Superman makes short work of the monsters and captures the evil Satana.

Episodes.Title: Rain of Iron (1)
Episodes.Description: Lois meets a man named Vamore who is known to be a friend of the escaped criminal Professor Dujy. As Lois follows Vamore to a remote island, Superman must protect Metropolis from a wave of dangerous iron spheres that threaten to destroy the city.

Episodes.Title: Rain of Iron (2)
Episodes.Description: Superman tracks the iron spheres to their source. They come from space, but are being bounced off an asteroid from a remote island in the Pacific. Professor Dujy and Vamore live on the island. When Superman comes to stop them, they try to take Lois hostage. Superman rescues Lois and sends Professor Dujy and Vamore to prison.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Mr. Mist (1)
Episodes.Description: Clark Kent and Lois Lane head to Perry White's farm for a picnic. Unfortunately, a strange mist follows them to the farm. The mist is capable of transforming itself into a person when it inhabits clothing. It reveals that it is dangerous when it attacks Lois.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Mr. Mist (2)
Episodes.Description: Superman saves Lois from the mysterious must. Unfortunately, it follows Lois back to Metropolis and tries to kidnap her. It wants Lois to be the queen of an underground kingdom. Eventually, the mist gets into the Superman museum and pretends to be Superboy. Superman captures the mist and seals it in the bottom of a very deep well.

Episodes.Title: Luminians on the Loose (1)
Episodes.Description: Lex Luthor transports to Earth two aliens that are made of pure light. They are called Luminians and have the capacity to destroy anything they touch. Luthor wants them to destroy Superman but is disappointed to discover that they cannot effect the Man of Steel.

Episodes.Title: Luminians on the Loose (2)
Episodes.Description: When the Luminians discover that they cannot injure Superman, they decide to turn against Lex Luthor. Superman saves Luthor and the two work together in trying to send the Luminians back to their home world.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost of Kilbane Castle (1)
Episodes.Description: Clark Kent, Lois Lane, and Jimmy Olsen are in Scotland. As Clark heads off to sleep at a local inn, Lois and Jimmy head to the mysterious Kilbane Castle. There two twins try to scare the reporters off the property. The twins don't want them to discover that their clan stole the castle from another clan. Unfortunately, their scare tactics manage to awaken a ghost from the other clan.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost of Kilbane Castle (2)
Episodes.Description: The ghost of Kilbane Castle awakens and soon terrorizes Lois and Jimmy. The ghost is upset that another clan has taken over his castle. Superman arrives and rescues Lois and Jimmy. He arrests the twins that awakened the ghost and assures the ghost that the castle will soon be returned to its rightful owner.

Episodes.Title: The Japanese Sandman (1)
Episodes.Description: Clark and Jimmy are in Japan covering a story about how a powerful industrialist is the victim of sabotage. The saboteur calls forth a mysterious Japanese Sandman that has the power of blowing sand that can cause magical sleep. The saboteur wants the Sandman to help him against the industrialist.

Episodes.Title: The Japanese Sandman (2)
Episodes.Description: Superman must stop the Sandman and deal with a saboteur before they can cause any more damage. When they finally meet, Superman fights off the Sandman's powerful sleeping sand and rescues Jimmy from a trap set by the saboteur. In the end, Superman captures the saboteur and defeats the Sandman.

Entries.Title: Batman: Caped Crusader
Entries.Description: A series of explosions rocks Gotham. Batman finds himself in the middle of a turf war between rival crime bosses Rupert Thorne and the Penguin. Meanwhile, Commissioner Gordon and his daughter Barbara look for ways to fix Gotham's corrupt Criminal Justice System from the inside.

Episodes.Title: In Treacherous Waters
Episodes.Description: A series of explosions rocks Gotham. Batman finds himself in the middle of a turf war between rival crime bosses Rupert Thorne and the Penguin. Meanwhile, Commissioner Gordon and his daughter Barbara look for ways to fix Gotham's corrupt Criminal Justice System from the inside.

Episodes.Title: ...And Be a Villain
Episodes.Description: When a glamorous movie star disappears, Batman and Detective Montoya find themselves tangled up in the dark web of a mysterious avenger haunting the soundstages.

Episodes.Title: Kiss of the Catwoman
Episodes.Description: After her multi-millionaire father goes to prison, leaving her strapped for cash, thrill-seeking dilettante Selina Kyle turns to a life of crime as the daring Catwoman, evading the law at every turn. Batman hatches a plan to end her crime spree while two renegade police detectives intend to see that she uses up all her nine lives in one fell swoop.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the Hunters
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Jessop assembles a task force to catch Batman, Detective Montoya is put in charge. Detectives Flass and Bullock take matters into their own hands in an attempt to trap Batman, putting Gotham in a fiery jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: The Stress of Her Regard
Episodes.Description: Someone is kidnapping and brain-washing rich, powerful men in Gotham, and Batman must find out who and why. When Barbara Gordon begins to suspect that one of her friends may be involved in the abductions, her investigation puts her on a collision course with the Dark Knight.

Episodes.Title: Night Ride
Episodes.Description: After a series of robberies in Gotham, Batman wrestles with the possibility that the culprit might be from beyond the grave. Meanwhile, Harvey Dent's morality is tested when a generous campaign donation comes in from a most nefarious source.

Episodes.Title: Moving Target
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of a botched assassination attempt on Commissioner Gordon's life, Montoya vows to do everything in her power to protect Gordon. Batman's investigation into who was behind the hit leads him down a rabbit hole with only one clear answer: trust no one.

Episodes.Title: Nocturne
Episodes.Description: When children start going missing at a Harvey Dent campaign event, Batman's sleuthing into the underbelly of a local carnival hosting it uncovers something far more sinister.

Episodes.Title: The Killer Inside Me
Episodes.Description: After Harvey Dent's accident, both Batman and Bruce Wayne must work to stop the DA on his quest for the wrong sort of justice.

Episodes.Title: Savage Night
Episodes.Description: Barbara Gordon and Batman's attempt to keep Harvey Dent safe until he testifies in court leads to an all-out war between Gotham's heroes and villains.

Entries.Title: Iron Man: Armored Adventures
Entries.Description: Tony Stark is left the sole survivor when his father's plane crashes. Now an orphan, he is presented with a questionable 'last request' of his father: live with the Rhodes and go to school. Encouraged by Pepper Potts and assisted by Jim Rhodes, the 16 year old genius begins to investigate the suspicious activities carried out by Obadiah Stane, the new C.E.O. of Stark Industries. But an even deadlier foe is waiting... The Mandarin.

Episodes.Title: Iron Forged in Fire: Part One
Episodes.Description: Tony Stark is left the sole survivor when his father's plane crashes. Now an orphan, he is presented with a questionable 'last request' of his father: live with the Rhodes and go to school. Encouraged by Pepper Potts and assisted by Jim Rhodes, the 16 year old genius begins to investigate the suspicious activities carried out by Obadiah Stane, the new C.E.O. of Stark Industries. But an even deadlier foe is waiting... The Mandarin.

Episodes.Title: Iron Forged in Fire: Part Two
Episodes.Description: Mandarin has trouble win his son, Gene Khan, while trying to retrieve the rings. Tony Stark as Iron Man battles his invention that Obadiah transformed into a weapon. Mandarin steals the ring of Obadiah, and fights Iron Man. Back in Mandarin's lair it is revealed that Gene Khan has become The Mandarin.

Episodes.Title: Secrets and Lies
Episodes.Description: After Tony is captured by a secret organization, he learns that Gene's father has something to do with it.

Episodes.Title: Cold War
Episodes.Description: Despite Rhodey's reservations, Iron Man builds an alliance with a man named Blizzard. Wanting to take out Obadiah Stane, Tony feels that the new partnership will be beneficial. But is Blizzard all that he seems to be?

Episodes.Title: Whip Lash
Episodes.Description: When Pepper's father is targeted by arms dealer Mister Fix, Tony must save the day without revealing his secret. However, this task becomes nearly impossible when Mister Fix sends his agent Whiplash after Pepper.

Episodes.Title: Iron Man VS The Crimson Dynamo
Episodes.Description: Ivan Vanko, a scientist who was thought to have been left in space two years ago, crash lands in New York City. Alive because of an environmental suit, called the Crimson Dynamo, Vanko seeks revenge on the program that put him in space in the first place- Project Pegasus. It's up to Iron Man to stop Vanko from destroying Project Pegasus.

Episodes.Title: Meltdown
Episodes.Description: The pressures of living a normal teenage life and being Iron Man become too much for Tony. Deciding he doesn't need school anymore, Tony quits and focuses on saving the world as Iron Man full time. But when a new villain, called the Living Laser, appears, Tony learns that he has to graduate in order to take over Stark Industries.

Episodes.Title: Field Trip
Episodes.Description: Tony sneaks into Stark International to catch a glimpse of the new Stealth Armor. Unfortunately, the building locks down and Tony is stuck inside. With the help of Rhodey and Pepper, Tony must find a way out of the building without revealing his secret identity.

Episodes.Title: Ancient History 101
Episodes.Description: Tony and his friends' search for the ancient Makluan Rings goes awry when the guardians of the Rings, the Dreadknights, arrive.

Episodes.Title: Ready, A.I.M., Fire
Episodes.Description: During the school science fair, Tony is approached by the leaders of an organization known as the Advanced Idea Mechanics. Offering up his help, Tony inadvertantly creates a new enemy, the Controller. With Tony's friends under its control, Iron Man must step in and save the day.

Episodes.Title: Masquerade
Episodes.Description: When Obadiah Stane starts acting strangely, Iron Man investigates. It turns out that Madame Masque, a shape shifting villain, was posing as Obadiah and she has a new target: Iron Man. Now, Tony must clear Iron Man's name after the police come looking for him.

Episodes.Title: Seeing Red
Episodes.Description: Project Pegasus, under the control of Obadiah Stane, creates an upgraded version of the Crimson Dynamo. With it, they capture Iron Man and begin analyzing the suit. After Rhodey and Pepper bust Iron Man out, Tony is ready for revenge. This time, Iron Man takes on the Crimson Dynamo with help from his new upgrade- the Dynamo Buster Armor.

Episodes.Title: Hide and Seek
Episodes.Description: When Tony and Gene find the third Makluan Ring, they argue over what exactly to do with it. Taking matters into his own hands, Gene accidentally unlocks the ring's guardian, Ultimo. Iron Man tries to detain Ultimo, but is forced to deal with the return of the Mandarin as well.

Episodes.Title: Man and Iron Man
Episodes.Description: Mister Fix equips Whiplash with a deadly new virus that infects Iron Man's suit. When Iron Man goes online by itself, Tony is stuck inside the suit. Unable to find a way out, Tony fears that he'll never be able to leave Iron Man behind.

Episodes.Title: Panther's Prey
Episodes.Description: When Iron Man tracks Moses Magnum to A.I.M.'s secret headquarters, he meets someone else who's after Magnum, the Black Panther. Thinking they'll be able to work together, Iron Man goes to the Black Panther for help. Unfortunately, Black Panther is only after Magnum and threatens to reveal Tony's secret if he gets in the way.

Episodes.Title: Fun with Lasers
Episodes.Description: When the Living Laser threatens the Earth via a space satellite, Iron Man steps in to save the day. Soon, however, Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D. contact Tony and tell him not to interfere. Not knowing who to fully trust, Tony is left feeling unsure of what to do.

Episodes.Title: Chasing Ghosts
Episodes.Description: When the Ghost comes after Tony, Madame Masque mysteriously steps in to protect him. Fearing that his friends will get hurt, Tony begins to push them away. Unfortunately, the Ghost captures Madame Masque and Tony is forced to call on his friends for help.

Episodes.Title: Pepper, Interrupted
Episodes.Description: When Pepper gets caught up in the middle of a feud between the Tong and the Maggia, the Mandarin calls on an unlikely source for help - Iron Man.

Episodes.Title: Technovore
Episodes.Description: After Tony accidentally creates an evil virus known as Technovore, he believes that it is gone for good. Unfortunately, the virus grows bigger and sets its sights on Iron Man.

Episodes.Title: World on Fire
Episodes.Description: Upon retrieving the fourth Makluan Ring, Gene recalls memories of his mother and his birthright. The guardian of said Ring, Firebrand, traps Pepper and Rhodey inside an active volcano and Iron Man must get them out before it erupts.

Episodes.Title: Designed Only for Chaos
Episodes.Description: A.I.M. uses a dying Living Laser to power up their newest creation- the Mental Organism Designed Only for Conquest. When Iron Man can't beat MODOC's mental powers, it's up to the Living Laser to save his life.

Episodes.Title: Don't Worry be Happy
Episodes.Description: After Tony lets Rhodey take the Iron Man suit out for a spin, it falls into the hands of Happy Hogan. Now, Tony must help Hogan take down a Maggia plot, all while not revealing his secret.

Episodes.Title: Uncontrollable
Episodes.Description: The Controller uses a boy named Rick Jones to get the Hulk to take revenge on A.I.M. Stepping in, Iron Man is taken over by the Controller and only the Hulk can stop him.

Episodes.Title: Best Served Cold
Episodes.Description: Obadiah Stane calls on Tony to find a cure for his daughter Whitney's disease. Knowing of a cure that exists in an abandoned Stark facility in the Arctic, Iron Man heads off to find it. Unable to sit around and do nothing, Stane forces Blizzard to go get the cure as well.

Episodes.Title: Tales of Suspense: Part 1
Episodes.Description: Zhang, Gene Khan's father and the former Mandarin, captures Tony and his friends in order to retrieve all five Makluan Rings. When the guardian of the fifth ring is released, the mighty dragon Fin Fang Foom becomes quite a challenge for the gang. Will Tony and Gene be able to save the day without the help of the Iron Man suit or the other Makluan Rings?

Episodes.Title: Tales of Suspense: Part 2
Episodes.Description: Doning the War Machine suit, Rhodey arrives just in time to save his friends from Fin Fang Foom. Now, it's the battle of the century as Iron Man and War Machine face off against Fin Fang Foom and the Mandarin.

Episodes.Title: The Invincible Iron Man Part 1: Disassembled!
Episodes.Description: Tony must use his armor for the first time in months when Mr. Fix's boss orders the abduction of Justin Hammer and Obadiah Stane.

Episodes.Title: The Invincible Iron Man Part 2: Reborn!
Episodes.Description: With his father's company on the line, Tony must wear his new armor and join War Machine to defeat his enemies.

Episodes.Title: Look Into the Light
Episodes.Description: When Mr. Fix is split into two halves, the Light Half seeks Iron Man's help in preventing the Dark Half from destroying the planet.

Episodes.Title: Ghost in the Machine
Episodes.Description: Stane hires a ghost to help him acquire the Iron Man armor.

Episodes.Title: Armor Wars
Episodes.Description: Stane creates mass-produced heroes using Tony's stolen specifications; Iron Man must try to discredit the new heroes.

Episodes.Title: Line of Fire
Episodes.Description: While investigating attacks on Hammer Multinational, Tony uncovers Stark International's involvement in a civil war.

Episodes.Title: Titanium vs. Iron
Episodes.Description: Hammer's new creation badly damages War Machine and nearly destroys the Iron Man armor.

Episodes.Title: The Might of Doom
Episodes.Description: Doctor Doom arrives in New York to collect stolen Iron Man specs.

Episodes.Title: The Hawk and the Spider
Episodes.Description: Iron Man has a difficult time stopping thieves from stealing the UI chip.

Episodes.Title: Enter: Iron Monger
Episodes.Description: Stane perfects a more powerful armor; Tony and Rhodey must use their brains.

Episodes.Title: Fugitive of S.H.I.E.L.D.
Episodes.Description: Nick Fury seeks Iron Man's help when plans are stolen from S.H.I.E.L.D.; Black Widow sets up Iron Man.

Episodes.Title: All the Best People Are Mad
Episodes.Description: Rhona turns Tomorrow Academy into a maze of traps for Tony and his schoolmates.

Episodes.Title: Heavy Mettle
Episodes.Description: After Stane is fired from Stark International, he discovers Iron Man's identity and plans to destroy him.

Episodes.Title: Mandarin's Quest
Episodes.Description: Mandarin offers Tony information about his father in exchange for Tony's help in claiming the eighth Makluan ring.

Episodes.Title: Hostile Takeover
Episodes.Description: When Hammer buys out Stark International, Tony vows to reveal his true nature to the world.

Episodes.Title: Extremis
Episodes.Description: When Agent Mallen is fired, he takes a serum and mutates into a maniac bent on revenge.

Episodes.Title: The X-Factor
Episodes.Description: Tony discovers that his new friend is a mutant on the run from Magneto.

Episodes.Title: Iron Man 2099
Episodes.Description: In the future, Tony Stark’s grandson Andros is Iron Man 2099. Except his time-travelling super-armor isn’t designed to save the day, but instead to eliminate Tony Stark!

Episodes.Title: Control-Alt-Delete
Episodes.Description: Tony wakes up in a virtual world created by the Controller in a plan to enslave the city.

Episodes.Title: Doomsday
Episodes.Description: After Dr. Doom captures the ninth ring and Tony's father, Iron Man must team up with an enemy to stop him.

Episodes.Title: The Hammer Falls
Episodes.Description: To keep his company from the Starks, an increasingly insane Justin Hammer unleashes Titanium Man on his former henchmen and develops a sinister zombie gas!

Episodes.Title: Rage of the Hulk
Episodes.Description: Fugitive scientist Bruce Banner seeks out the Starks for help, but when the Army co-opts S.H.I.E.L.D. to make an attack, Iron Man must fight and subdue the Hulk in order to save him!

Episodes.Title: Iron Monger Lives
Episodes.Description: Someone is after Rhodey and Pepper and sets a explosive in the armory. Meanwhile, Obadiah Stane and Iron Monger return, and Iron Man learns that it is not really Stane as the pilot. In the end, the pilot turns out to be Whitney Stane (Madame Masque) who is looking to get revenge on Tony Stark.

Episodes.Title: The Dragonseed
Episodes.Description: Pepper gets a suit. Gene finds the tenth ring, defeats the last guardian which turns out to be a Makluan. Howard Stark reveals to Tony that he knew that he was Iron Man the whole time.

Episodes.Title: The Makluan Invasion Part 1: Annihilate!
Episodes.Description: Mandarin signals the Makluan Overlord's alien fleet to invade Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Makluan Invasion Part 2: Unite!
Episodes.Description: Iron Man, War Machine and Rescue must unite Nick Fury, Hawkeye, Black Widow, Black Panther and the Hulk to stop the Makluan Overlord from destroying the Earth.

Entries.Title: Marvel's Future Avengers
Entries.Description: Three kids escape from Hydra's captivity.

Episodes.Title: Destroy the Avengers
Episodes.Description: Three kids escape from Hydra's captivity.

Episodes.Title: Avengers Assemble!
Episodes.Description: The Avengers lay siege to Hydra Island.

Episodes.Title: The Red Skull Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: The Avengers transport Red Skull to the Raft.

Episodes.Title: Future Avengers: Assemble!
Episodes.Description: The Future Avengers sneak out of the Avengers Tower.

Episodes.Title: Iron Fist
Episodes.Description: Thor and the Future Avengers visit Iron Fist.

Episodes.Title: Secret Past of Iron Man
Episodes.Description: Secret past of Iron Man.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes Deadpool
Episodes.Description: Deadpool visits Avengers Tower.

Episodes.Title: Super Soldier: Steve Rogers
Episodes.Description: Bruno is revived on Hydra Island.

Episodes.Title: Who is the Winter Soldier?
Episodes.Description: Captain Marvel, Black Widow, and Hawkeye assemble.

Episodes.Title: Black Panther
Episodes.Description: Iron Man and Chloe got to Wakanda.

Episodes.Title: The Rampaging Hulk
Episodes.Description: Hulk quits the Avengers.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man to the Rescue
Episodes.Description: Green Goblin targets the Avengers.

Episodes.Title: Green Goblin vs The Hulk
Episodes.Description: Green Goblin steals the Hulkbuster armor.

Episodes.Title: The Flight of the Falcon
Episodes.Description: The Leader sabotages Iron Man's armor.

Episodes.Title: Ms. Marvel
Episodes.Description: Chloe meets Kamala Khan AKA Ms. Marvel.

Episodes.Title: Operation Rescue Winter Soldier
Episodes.Description: Captain America goes on a mission to Russia.

Episodes.Title: Finding Hydra's Comrades
Episodes.Description: Captain America teams up with the Winter Guard

Episodes.Title: It's Deadpool Again
Episodes.Description: Deadpool kidnaps Makoto

Episodes.Title: Can You Believe in Loki
Episodes.Description: The Avengers team up with Loki.

Episodes.Title: The Bond of Brothers
Episodes.Description: The Avengers battle the Masters of Evil

Episodes.Title: Conqueror Kang
Episodes.Description: Kang arrives to conquer the earth.

Episodes.Title: The Darkest Hour
Episodes.Description: The Future Avengers take the fight to Kang.

Episodes.Title: Out of Time
Episodes.Description: The Avengers travel back in time.

Episodes.Title: Operation Barrier Breakthrough
Episodes.Description: Makoto and Bruno team up against Kang.

Episodes.Title: The Final Fateful Battle
Episodes.Description: The Avengers launch their final assault on Kang

Episodes.Title: The Future Avengers
Episodes.Description: Kang threatens to crash his Time Fortress into Earth.

Episodes.Title: Visco Rebels
Episodes.Description: VISCO tries to destroy the city!

Episodes.Title: Mission Black Market Auction
Episodes.Description: Chloe teams up with Black Widow and Wasp.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes Hawkeye
Episodes.Description: Adi teams up with Hawkeye.

Episodes.Title: The Boy Who Draws Monsters
Episodes.Description: The Future Avengers meet Kid Kaiju

Episodes.Title: The Great Kaiju Showdown
Episodes.Description: The Avengers and Kid Kaiju battle evil Kaiju.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery Mist
Episodes.Description: A new villain named Blizzard seeks revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt for A.I.M.
Episodes.Description: The Avengers investigate the strange mist.

Episodes.Title: The Super Adaptoid Strikes
Episodes.Description: The Avengers save the afflicted from MODOK.

Episodes.Title: The Inhumans Arrive!
Episodes.Description: The Inhumans arrive and battle the Avengers.

Episodes.Title: Moon Landing
Episodes.Description: Chloe and Kamala arrive in the moon city of Attilan.

Episodes.Title: The Rage of Black Bolt
Episodes.Description: Maximus declares war against the Avengers and Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Maximus Armada
Episodes.Description: Chloe and Kamala uncover Maximus' plot for power.

Episodes.Title: The Avengers: Last Stand
Episodes.Description: The Avengers defeat Maximus and save Earth.

Entries.Title: Ragnarok The Animation
Entries.Description: Young swordsman Roan and his comrade Yufa face a spreading darkness after meeting a blindfolded mage.

Episodes.Title: Why Do You Wield That Sword?
Episodes.Description: Young swordsman Roan and his comrade Yufa face a spreading darkness after meeting a blindfolded mage.

Episodes.Title: Be Good to Me, Big Brother
Episodes.Description: Roan and Yufa look for the Golden Thief Bug and a girl named Maya threatens to hinder their progress.

Episodes.Title: I Believe
Episodes.Description: Roan and his band join forces with Takius as they journey into the pits and haunted dungeons beneath Geffen Tower.

Episodes.Title: Is That the Best You Can Do?
Episodes.Description: Roan, Yufa, Maya and Takius return to the dungeons of Geffen Tower to defeat the evil that plagues the tower.

Episodes.Title: What Did You Just Say?
Episodes.Description: A shocking revelation turns Yufa's world upside down and tensions begin to mount.

Episodes.Title: I Won't Let Anyone Get in My Way!
Episodes.Description: Yufa sets out for a reunion after hearing that her brother may still be alive.

Episodes.Title: Will You Comfort Me?!?
Episodes.Description: Roan and his comrades journey to Alberta to investigate a monster infestation.

Episodes.Title: Life Is Precious
Episodes.Description: The travelers take a shortcut through the notorious Labyrinth Forest, only to talk in circles.

Episodes.Title: All for the Truth
Episodes.Description: Takius convinces the travelers to make a detour to an underground lair inhabited by enormous ants.

Episodes.Title: You're My Brother, Aren't You?!?
Episodes.Description: Roan and friends reach the city of Morroc, home of the Thief's Guild.

Episodes.Title: All Is Only Despair
Episodes.Description: Rai is tricked into opening the tomb of King Osiris, unleashing a horde of ghastly monsters.

Episodes.Title: I Can't Do It
Episodes.Description: Following the battle with Osiris, the group heads toward the Assassin's guild; Yufa struggles with her brother's death.

Episodes.Title: The Protector
Episodes.Description: Roan must join forces with adversaries to protect Yufa.

Episodes.Title: Why Won't You Answer?
Episodes.Description: The clock tower's bell begins to ring, summoning lethal monsters.

Episodes.Title: Don't Worry, I'm Here
Episodes.Description: Roan returns from his mission with new skills and the rank of a fully-ordained Crusader.

Episodes.Title: I Can't Save Anyone
Episodes.Description: Roan and his group travel to the ancient city of Payon to stop a outbreak of violent and destructive monsters.

Episodes.Title: You Are Already Tainted
Episodes.Description: While Roan and a group of Archers attempt to hold off the monsters, Takius's master makes his presence known; Yufa prepares herself for challenges that could earn her the title of Priest.

Episodes.Title: I've Known All Along
Episodes.Description: Roan may have uncovered the key to stopping the monsters; Yufa rejoins her friends as a newly-appointed Priest.

Episodes.Title: We'll Always Be Together
Episodes.Description: Missing the ferry to the Parol Lighthouse turns out to be more than just bad luck.

Episodes.Title: It's Okay
Episodes.Description: Maya is devastated over her role in what happened to Alice; Yufa continues her battle with Haze.

Episodes.Title: I Need You
Episodes.Description: Haze and Zealotus continue to spread darkness throughout the realm; Roan crosses paths with the Dark Lord's emissaries of destruction.

Episodes.Title: Who's the Lonely One?
Episodes.Description: The group finally reaches Comodo, where they encounter familiar rivals; Iruga vows to save Keough; Comodo must be snatched from the clutches of a deadly scourge.

Episodes.Title: Good Bye
Episodes.Description: Comodo is under siege while Roan, Iruga, and Judia fight to stave off the onslaught of an army of monsters.

Episodes.Title: Place of Reckoning
Episodes.Description: Roan's group travels to Glast Heim in search of Yufa and her dangerous brother Haze.

Episodes.Title: One Who Realizes His Mistake
Episodes.Description: Roan watches Yufa suffer at the hands of Haze; Takius and Zephyr finally meet on the field of battle.

Episodes.Title: For the Sake of Our Future
Episodes.Description: The Dark Lord's return is imminent, and Roan will have to use every skill to overcome this hideous force of evil.

Entries.Title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
Entries.Description: The newly-christened Guardians of the Galaxy come into possession of a dangerous artifact that has Thanos’ new lieutenant, Korath, after them.

Episodes.Title: Road to Knowhere
Episodes.Description: The newly-christened Guardians of the Galaxy come into possession of a dangerous artifact that has Thanos’ new lieutenant, Korath, after them.

Episodes.Title: Knowhere to Run
Episodes.Description: The Guardians struggle to subdue the suddenly-sprung-to-life Celestial head that is the Knowhere space colony, as well as storm Korath’s ship to rescue Quill, Gamora and the mysterious CryptoCube that holds the Cosmic Seed.

Episodes.Title: One in a Million You
Episodes.Description: Feeling underappreciated, Rocket accepts an offer to work for The Collector, only to realize his “job” is working as another prisoner in The Collector’s collection.

Episodes.Title: Take the Milano and Run
Episodes.Description: The Guardians crash land on a space station run by the Grandmaster, who schemes to get Drax back in the gladiatorial arena to battle his ultimate opponent: Gamora.

Episodes.Title: Can't Fight This Seedling
Episodes.Description: When Groot is infected by a parasitic fungus, the Guardians must embark on a perilous journey in order to save him.

Episodes.Title: Undercover Angle
Episodes.Description: Caught red-handed by Titus, the Guardians are coerced into infiltrating a notorious gang of weapons dealers known as the Black Order.

Episodes.Title: The Backstabbers
Episodes.Description: Quill gets mixed up in a game of deceit when Gamora tries to pit her siblings, Nebula and Korath, against each other.

Episodes.Title: Hitchin' a Ride
Episodes.Description: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits â€” fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

Episodes.Title: We Are Family
Episodes.Description: Rocket is abducted and taken back to his home planet, Half World.

Episodes.Title: Bad Moon Rising
Episodes.Description: The Guardians encounter a living planet that's fallen under the control of a revived Ronan.

Episodes.Title: Space Cowboys
Episodes.Description: The Guardians get caught up in a rivalry between The Collector and The Grandmaster.

Episodes.Title: Crystal Blue Persuasion
Episodes.Description: The Guardians must help save the City of Attilan from Ronan.

Episodes.Title: Stuck in the Metal with You
Episodes.Description: The Guardians find the Asgardian Destroyer Armor that leads to an epic battle pitting the Detroyer Armor against Drax the Destroyer.

Episodes.Title: Don't Stop Believin'
Episodes.Description: Quill goes missing while following the Cryptocube's readings.

Episodes.Title: Accidents Will Happen
Episodes.Description: The Guardians must stop Ronan's plan to blow up the Kree Supreme Intelligence.

Episodes.Title: We Are the World Tree
Episodes.Description: In search of the Cosmic Seed, the Guardians unexpectedly find themselves in Asgard where they must outwit Thor and Angela in order to discover the seed's origins.

Episodes.Title: Come and Gut Your Love
Episodes.Description: Following a falling out with his father, Star-Lord finds a ship containing the A.I. Rora as he takes it off of Spartax with the Drax the Destroyer and Groot providing a diversion for the Spartax Royal Guards. Afterwards, the Guardians of the Galaxy have to deal with Lucy and Supergiant who are jilted that Star-Lord is the Prince of Sparta.

Episodes.Title: Asgard War (1): Lightnin' Strikes
Episodes.Description: When Asgard attacks Spartax, Quill and the Guardians become caught in the middle trying to expose the deception behind the conflict.

Episodes.Title: Asgard War (2): Rescue Me
Episodes.Description: The Guardians and Asgardians team up to rescue Quill from Thanos.

Episodes.Title: Fox on the Run
Episodes.Description: Gamora attempts to make amends for her past misdeeds only to find herself in a deadly trap set by Nebula, Ronan and the Grandmaster.

Episodes.Title: Inhuman Touch
Episodes.Description: The Guardians pay the Inhumans a visit to learn more about the Cosmic Seed.

Episodes.Title: Welcome Back
Episodes.Description: The Guardians discover that the Cosmic Seed is back on Earth. In the company of Cosmo, Star-Lord returns to his hometown where he runs into his childhood bully Michael Coogan who is now the sheriff. Now Star-Lord and the Guardians of the Galaxy must find the Cosmic Seed before Korath the Pursuer does.

Episodes.Title: I've Been Searching So Long
Episodes.Description: When the Guardians of the Galaxy's search for the Cosmic Seed continues on Earth, Star-Lord contacts Gorgon where he gets the location of the former site of Attilan. While checking out the area, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, and Drax the Destroyer have visions of the Cosmic Seed energy helping them out like Rocket Raccoon's family being re-evolved, Groot being able to restore the Flora colossi, and Drax the Destroyer being able to see his family again. Even after fighting their way past the Cosmic Seed-enhanced worms and spiders, the Guardians of the Galaxy must keep Ronan the Accuser and Nebula from getting the box containing the Cosmic Seed.

Episodes.Title: I Feel the Earth Move
Episodes.Description: Now that Thanos has the Cosmic Seed, he takes control of the Earth and molds it into his personal planetary weapon of mass destruction. The Guardians of the Galaxy must work to reclaim the Cosmic Seed from Thanos even when Ronan the Accuser and Nebula plan to dispose of Thanos with plans of having the Earth be destroyed alongside him.

Episodes.Title: Won't Get Fooled Again
Episodes.Description: The Guardians discover that Yondu has been impersonating them in order to con unsuspecting victims.

Episodes.Title: Jingle Bell Rock
Episodes.Description: The team stages a Christmas Carol inspired con-job in order to frighten a despot out of his ill-gotten riches and free his enslaved people.

Episodes.Title: Stayin' Alive
Episodes.Description: While trying to dispose of Thanos' asteroid, the Guardians discover it has been taken to a secure facility that belongs to the Avengers.

Episodes.Title: Evolution Rock
Episodes.Description: The Guardians and the Avengers team up to find out what powerful secrets lie inside Thanos' asteroid.

Episodes.Title: Lyin' Eyes
Episodes.Description: When Rocket and Drax wake up with absolutely no memory of the night before, the Guardians must piece together their adventures.

Episodes.Title: Free Bird
Episodes.Description: While the Guardians search for the missing sarcophagus, Groot finds a mysterious egg and does everything in his power to protect it.

Episodes.Title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
Episodes.Description: When the Guardians are charged with escorting the young and rebellious Rigellian Princess Tana back home, Drax's hardened heart melts as he is reminded of his own daughter.

Episodes.Title: Black Helmet Woman
Episodes.Description: After being infused with incredible power from a Nova Helmet, Gamora leads the Guardians and her sister Nebula on a mission to infiltrate the Believer flagship.

Episodes.Title: Right Place, Wrong Time
Episodes.Description: Quill and Gamora battle the High Evolutionary, his minion hybrids and a teleport-hijacking Nebula.

Episodes.Title: Me and You and a Dog Named Cosmo
Episodes.Description: Cosmo goes undercover on the Believer Flagship but loses his powers when his cover is blown.

Episodes.Title: Can't Get It Out Of My Head
Episodes.Description: When the Believer Flagship embeds itself in Knowhere's brain, it causes a planetoid-wide telekinetic zombie outbreak.

Episodes.Title: Rock Your Baby
Episodes.Description: When the cocoon opens and reveals a baby warlock inside, the Guardians have to step in to be a positive guiding force to keep his powers in check.

Episodes.Title: Symbiote War (1): Wild World
Episodes.Description: The Guardians discover Groot's homeworld, Planet X, has been overrun by Symbiotes who will stop at nothing to get Groot's restarted World Pod for themselves to conquer the galaxy.

Episodes.Title: Symbiote War (2): I Will Survive
Episodes.Description: As a comet covered in Symbiotes hurls toward Spartax, the Guardians must team up with Quill's sister to save the planet.

Episodes.Title: Symbiote War (3): Thunder Road
Episodes.Description: When the Symbiotes escape to Asgard and venomize Thor, Odin and the other Asgardians, it is up to the Guardians to save them, the World Tree and all of existence.

Episodes.Title: Back in Black
Episodes.Description: The Guardians meet Sam Alexander, an Earth teen experimenting with his father’s Nova helmet, but the Guardians aren’t the only ones who know of the helmet’s power.

Episodes.Title: Knights in Black Helmets
Episodes.Description: The Guardians chase after J’son and Mantis as they try to manipulate Sam to do their bidding by promising him clues to the location of his missing father.

Episodes.Title: Nova Me, Nova You
Episodes.Description: When the Nova Corps catch up with the Guardians and Sam, the fight reaches Sam’s hometown.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Roboto
Episodes.Description: Searching for a weapon strong enough to match J’son, the Guardians seek out master boom-maker Ja Kyee.

Episodes.Title: Destroyer
Episodes.Description: When the guardians travel to Drax's home planet in hopes of summoning Warlock, they discover Xeron seeks to destroy Adam and Drax's homecoming, which becomes a fight to protect his friends.

Episodes.Title: You Can't Always Get What You Want
Episodes.Description: Rocket and Warlock travel to Halfworld to try and re-evolve Rocket's family.

Episodes.Title: I've Seen All Good People
Episodes.Description: Gamora trains Warlock to be a strong and powerful warrior like herself. But when Gamora’s lessons become too intense, Warlock clams up and gets kidnapped by the Collector.

Episodes.Title: Another One Bites the Dust
Episodes.Description: When Quill and Warlock are hunted by J'son and the Black Order, Quill teaches Warlock the importance of never letting himself slip into the path of evil.

Episodes.Title: It's Tricky
Episodes.Description: During the Xandrian Feast of the Three Grinning Moons, the Guardians must pull a reverse heist by planting a dangerous weapon inside a Nova Corps vault.

Episodes.Title: You're No Good
Episodes.Description: Warlock has gone dark! By absorbing J’son into his gem, Warlock has become Dark Warlock (Magus) with his sights set on conquering the galaxy, starting with Spartax.

Episodes.Title: Behind Gold Eyes
Episodes.Description: The Guardians and Nova battle Dark Warlock (Magus) and J’son on Planet Y. Can our heroes save their friend Warlock and the universe before it’s too late?

Episodes.Title: Unfortunate Son
Episodes.Description: In order to save the Guardians from the ruthless asteroid Korvac, Quill must bust J'Son out of prison on Spartax and in the process he sees a new side of his father.

Episodes.Title: Mission: Breakout
Episodes.Description: The Guardians must work together to escape the elaborate prisons created for them by The Collector.

Episodes.Title: Back in the New York Groove
Episodes.Description: The Guardians meet up with Spider-Man in New York City to defeat Thanos’ super-powered symbiote.

Episodes.Title: Drive My Carnage
Episodes.Description: The Guardians team up with Spider-Man to battle Thanos, who has harnessed the power of the Carnage Symbiote to become the ultimate weapon.

Episodes.Title: I Fought the Law
Episodes.Description: The Guardians have captured Thanos, but it's no easy task transporting the most wanted criminal in the galaxy.

Episodes.Title: Titan Up
Episodes.Description: The Guardians chase Thanos and Sam Alexander (Nova) to Thanos’ home planet of Titan, where they discover a gladiatorial arena featuring Jesse Alexander - Nova’s father!

Episodes.Title: Money Changes Everything
Episodes.Description: The Guardians now have everything they ever dreamed of, but money can’t solve their problems.

Episodes.Title: Sisters Are Doin' It for Themselves
Episodes.Description: Gamora decides to use her new riches to repay all of the people she has wronged throughout the years. When Nebula shows up, Gamora tries to teach her the value of doing good.

Episodes.Title: We Are the Champions
Episodes.Description: Drax decides he no longer wants to be a Destroyer and looks into new occupations.

Episodes.Title: Fame
Episodes.Description: Quill starts his own talk show after beating Thanos! But to his dismay, everyone seems to hate it, especially the Grandmaster who is rigging the segments to destroy Quill.

Episodes.Title: Happy Together
Episodes.Description: The Guardians squander their riches and take on a simple transport job. It turns out that they are stealing from the Kree, and Phyla the Accuser will do anything to get it back!

Episodes.Title: Gotta Get Outta this Place
Episodes.Description: The Guardians find themselves in prison for stealing a mysterious package from the Kree - but it was all a set up by Howard the Duck.

Episodes.Title: Long Distance Runaround
Episodes.Description: The Guardians track down Howard the Duck to find out who set them up and why, but they don’t get far before Phyla the Accuser catches up to them to deliver some Kree justice.

Episodes.Title: You Don't Own Me
Episodes.Description: Phyla-Vell reluctantly teams up with the Guardians to bring The Collector to justice for destroying her home planet.

Episodes.Title: Black Vortex (1)
Episodes.Description: When the Guardians become separated in the Black Vortex, Gamora wakes up in a children’s fairy tale, while Drax is trapped in a comic book.

Episodes.Title: Black Vortex (2)
Episodes.Description: While caught in a CG sinister packing factory, Rocket must search for his best friend Groot and escape.

Episodes.Title: Black Vortex (3)
Episodes.Description: Quill finds himself in a claymation world where the Milano is flying into the sun, threatening to melt him. Meanwhile, Groot and Drax must fight Ronan in a Golden Age world.

Episodes.Title: Black Vortex (4)
Episodes.Description: Gamora and Quill battle their way through an 8-bit Super Marvel World.

Episodes.Title: Blame It on the Boss of Nova
Episodes.Description: The Guardians finally make it out of the Black Vortex, only to find that the galaxy has been taken over by sinister robots called the Darkhawks, who are disguised as their friends.

Episodes.Title: The Real Me
Episodes.Description: The Guardians don’t know who to trust as the Darkhawks seem to have duplicated everyone, including Quill.

Episodes.Title: Paranoid
Episodes.Description: The Guardians finally make it out of the Black Vortex, only to find that the galaxy has been taken over by sinister robots called the Darkhawks, who are disguised as their friends.

Episodes.Title: Darkhawks on the Edge of Town
Episodes.Description: The Guardians don't know who to trust as the Darkhawks seem to have duplicated everyone, including Quill.

Episodes.Title: Holding Out for a Hero
Episodes.Description: The Guardians have to team up with Loki in Asgard when The Serpent infects the World Tree and threatens to destroy the universe.

Episodes.Title: With a Little Help From My Friends
Episodes.Description: As the Guardians prepare to take the fight to The Serpent, they Bifrost around the galaxy to gather reinforcements.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Stuff is Hard to Do
Episodes.Description: The Guardians and their friends search for the fragments of Dragonfang, a legendary weapon that will finally be able to defeat The Serpent forever.

Episodes.Title: Killer Queen
Episodes.Description: The Guardians, Loki and Iron Man travel to the castle of the evil Hela to ask her help in fighting The Serpent.

Episodes.Title: Just One Victory
Episodes.Description: With the Nova Corps defeated and the fate of the entire universe in jeopardy, the Guardians must turn to an unlikely ally to stop The Serpent.

Entries.Title: Arrow
Entries.Description: After a violent shipwreck, billionaire playboy Oliver Queen was missing and presumed dead for five years before being discovered alive on a remote island in the Pacific. Back in Starling City, Oliver slowly reconnects with those closest to him. Oliver has brought back many new skills from his time on the island and manages to secretly create the persona of Arrow to right the wrongs of his family and fight the ills of society. As Arrow, Oliver will atone for the past sins of his family while he searches for the personal redemption he needs.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: After a violent shipwreck, billionaire playboy Oliver Queen was missing and presumed dead for five years before being discovered alive on a remote island in the Pacific. Back in Starling City, Oliver slowly reconnects with those closest to him. Oliver has brought back many new skills from his time on the island and manages to secretly create the persona of Arrow to right the wrongs of his family and fight the ills of society. As Arrow, Oliver will atone for the past sins of his family while he searches for the personal redemption he needs.

Episodes.Title: Honor Thy Father
Episodes.Description: Oliver heads to the courthouse to get his death certificate repealed and is pleasantly surprised to run into Laurel, who is there prosecuting Martin Somers, a criminal with ties to the Chinese Triad. Oliver recognizes Martin's name from his father's book and sets his sights on taking him down. Martin orders the Triad to "take care of" Laurel so they send their top mercenary - China White - after her, an act that culminates in a battle between Arrow and China White. Meanwhile, Moira and Walter ask Oliver to take over the company.

Episodes.Title: Lone Gunmen
Episodes.Description: Oliver is surprised when someone shoots and kills one of his targets. As his plan is to bring people to justice vs. outright killing them, Oliver doesn't appreciate the help and searches for the gunman. He soon learns that the man, Deadshot, is taking out businessmen who are scheduled to bid at an auction on an energy company and Walter is one of the bidders. Realizing he can't protect his family and stop Deadshot at the same time, Oliver enlists Detective Lance's help, but his plan has dire consequences. Meanwhile, Laurel and Tommy get caught in an awkward situation with Oliver.

Episodes.Title: An Innocent Man
Episodes.Description: Oliver still hasn't figured out how to get back in Laurel's good graces, but a late night bonding session with Thea gives him the inspiration he needs. Looking into a suspicious murder case, Oliver realizes an innocent man, Peter Declan, was framed by one of the targets on his list. As Arrow, he asks Laurel to help prove Declan's innocence. Meanwhile, Walter asks one of his employees, Felicity Smoak, to look into a $2.6 million withdrawal that Moira made without his knowledge.

Episodes.Title: Damaged
Episodes.Description: After Detective Lance arrests Oliver for murder, Oliver tells Moira the only lawyer he'll allow to represent him is Laurel. Laurel takes the case which puts her at odds with her father. Oliver offers to take a polygraph in front Detective Lance but things get tense when Lance asks him if anyone else was on the island with him. Oliver flashes back to when he got his first scar, courtesy of Deathstroke.

Episodes.Title: Legacies
Episodes.Description: A gang of bank robbers, dubbed The Royal Flush Gang, hits a local bank and seriously wounds an off-duty police officer during a heist. Diggle tells Oliver he needs to deviate from his father's list and start helping the citizens of Starling City. Meanwhile, Tommy asks Thea for relationship advice, but things get awkward when she realizes he was asking about Laurel. Moira confronts Oliver about all of his recent disappearances in the middle of family functions.

Episodes.Title: Muse of Fire
Episodes.Description: Oliver encounters a mysterious woman, Helena Bertinelli, daughter of mob boss Frank Bertinelli, who he can finally be himself with, but he soon comes to realize she's hiding dangerous secrets of her own. Helena is on her own personal mission of vengeance and Oliver is caught in the middle. Meanwhile, Tommy is blindsided by an unfortunate turn of events and turns to Laurel for support.

Episodes.Title: Vendetta
Episodes.Description: As Oliver and Helena grow closer, Oliver trains her to be his ally, complete with showing her how to use a crossbow. Diggle disapproves of Oliver sharing his secret with Helena as he's not sure she can be trusted, but Oliver refuses to listen to his concerns. Helena's quest for revenge proves to be too strong for Oliver to handle after she kills the head of the Triad and all hell breaks loose.

Episodes.Title: Year's End
Episodes.Description: Oliver discovers that after he and his father went missing, Moira and Thea stopped celebrating Christmas. Determined to make up for lost time and restore a sense of normalcy to the Queen household, Oliver decides to throw the family a Christmas party. Meanwhile, Tommy asks Laurel to spend Christmas with him but she points out that Christmas was also her sister Sara's birthday and she needs to be with her father. Tommy suggests changing things up might be the best way for everyone to heal but Laurel isn't sure her father is ready for that. Meanwhile, Diggle tells Oliver someone is murdering the people on his father's list with arrows, which sends Oliver off to face his toughest adversary yet.

Episodes.Title: Burned
Episodes.Description: Oliver’s confidence is shaken after being beaten by the Dark Archer and he takes a break from being Arrow. However, when Laurel calls Arrow for help investigating a firefighter’s suspicious death, he reluctantly agrees but his hesitance while fighting almost costs him his life. Meanwhile, Tommy throws a benefit for the firefighters and Thea tries to lift Moira out of her depressive state.

Episodes.Title: Trust But Verify
Episodes.Description: The next person on Arrow's list is Diggle's commanding officer and mentor from Afghanistan, Ted Gaynor. Oliver suspects Ted is responsible for recent armoured truck robberies, but Diggle defends Ted and takes a job at Ted's security company to keep an eye on him. Oliver decides to make a move on Ted, which puts him at odds with Diggle. Meanwhile, Thea suspects that Moira is having an affair with Malcom. Tommy and Laurel have an awkward dinner with Malcom.

Episodes.Title: Vertigo
Episodes.Description: Thea is in trouble with the police after she gets caught using a drug called "Vertigo." Oliver thinks the only way to keep her out of jail is to find the dealer, a man who goes by the name of "The Count". Oliver turns to McKenna Hall, an old flame and current Vice cop, for help. Meanwhile, Laurel steps in to defend Thea, and Felicity gives Oliver some disturbing news about Moira.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
