Episodes.Description: A news report from the Canadian mountains triggers something deep inside Wolverine, and he starts having berserk fits. To find out why, he takes the Blackbird to the site, not knowing that Kitty and Kurt are sitting in the back.

Episodes.Title: The Cauldron (1)
Episodes.Description: As mysterious metal pods appear, picking up the mutants one at a time, Cerebro detects a new mutant in Hawaii: Alex Summers - Scott's believed to be deceased brother.

Episodes.Title: The Cauldron (2)
Episodes.Description: Magneto reveals the his plans for the winners of his challenge - to fully unlock their powers with a machine he has built. Back at the mansion, those left behind regroup, and decide to pay Magneto a little visit.

Episodes.Title: Growing Pains
Episodes.Description: When Cyclops and Nightcrawler save people from a car crash they question Xavier's desire to keep their identities a secret. Meanwhile, the Brotherhood terrorize people in a crowded stadium.

Episodes.Title: Bada-Bing Bada-Boom
Episodes.Description: Nightcrawler has a crush on a new student. The wild girl is grounded for breaking the rules, but things get worse when her father arrives and asks that she help him in a bank robbery.

Episodes.Title: Power Surge
Episodes.Description: Jean's telepathy changes, arriving in surges she can't control; and Hank McCoy joins the faculty as a science-and-gym teacher.

Episodes.Title: Fun and Games
Episodes.Description: The young X-Men are left alone in the mansion when the adults respond to a jailbreak, and they throw a party that doesn't end well.

Episodes.Title: The Beast of Bayville
Episodes.Description: The serum Hank McCoy uses to control his mutation no longer works, and his students are afraid of his angry outbursts.

Episodes.Title: Adrift
Episodes.Description: Havok is swept out to sea while surfing in Hawaii, and Scott saves him, but they both end up stranded and have to work together to survive.

Episodes.Title: African Storm
Episodes.Description: The X-Men help Storm when her abilities are threatened by a visiting African witch doctor who attempts to steal her powers.

Episodes.Title: Joyride
Episodes.Description: Avalanche wants to join the Institute, but has trouble being accepted by the others, especially after he's accused of taking joyrides on the X-vehicles at night.

Episodes.Title: On Angel's Wings
Episodes.Description: Xavier suspects that a flying "angel" seen above New York is a mutant, and he sends Cyclops and Rogue to find him before Magneto does.

Episodes.Title: Mindbender
Episodes.Description: Jean is possessed by a mutant with telepathic powers, which he uses to control the students and have them help him in his plot to release the imprisoned Apocalypse, a mutant who wishes to enslave the human race.

Episodes.Title: Shadow Dance
Episodes.Description: Forge invents a teleporter, and Nightcrawler uses it to travel large distances, but inadvertently opens a portal that allows strange creatures to follow him back to the school.

Episodes.Title: Retreat
Episodes.Description: Beast is mistaken for Bigfoot by hunters while he's on a camping trip with the students.

Episodes.Title: Walk on the Wild Side
Episodes.Description: The women form a team of crime fighters after Jean and Amara are teased for having weaker powers, and they call themselves the Bayville Sirens.

Episodes.Title: Operation: Rebirth
Episodes.Description: Magneto steals plans for a top-secret project that produced super soldiers. Wolverine worked on it during World War II.

Episodes.Title: The HeX Factor
Episodes.Description: Mystique frees a mutant called the Scarlet Witch from an asylum, hoping she'll help the Brotherhood, but Mystique doesn't know the witch is seeking revenge on Quicksilver and Magneto.

Episodes.Title: Day of Reckoning (1)
Episodes.Description: At Xavier's urging, the Brotherhood and the X-Men unite to battle Magneto; and the Institute begins to self-destruct while students are trapped in the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Day of Reckoning (2)
Episodes.Description: A traitor in the battle threatens the efforts of the X-Men and the Brotherhood against Magneto, who has another secret weapon -- the Sentinel robot.

Episodes.Title: Day of Recovery
Episodes.Description: X-Men and the Brotherhood deal with the aftermath of the world finding out about mutants. The Institute is blown up, and Mystique posed as Prof. X to blow it up. Some of the X-Men and Brotherhood are captured, leaving the mutants that escaped to find them and the Professor.

Episodes.Title: The Stuff of Heroes
Episodes.Description: Rogue and Wolverine duck a squad of soldiers when the nationwide alert goes out against mutants, while Storm and Beast go into a meeting of Congress to defend themselves. Meanwhile Juggernaut goes on a rampage and the X-Men feel obliged to take him down.

Episodes.Title: Mainstream
Episodes.Description: During the rebuilding of the manor, Kitty and Kurt intercept a bunch of graffiti artists disguised as monsters. The older students get to go back to Bayville High for one day before attending a hearing to determine their ultimate fate, while they are banned from using their powers.

Episodes.Title: The Stuff of Villains
Episodes.Description: Wanda goes searching for Pietro. Meanwhile the brotherhood's members are expelled from school, much to Lance's dismay.

Episodes.Title: Blind Alley
Episodes.Description: Mystique escapes from imprisonment while the X-Men repair and rebuild the Institute. Disguised as Alex, she lures Scott into a trap - leaving him stranded in the middle of the Mexican desert without his glasses.

Episodes.Title: X-Treme Measures
Episodes.Description: Evan enters an extreme Skateboarding competition, and puts his skills to the test. But something is wrong: A mysterious woman is watching and following him during the competition.

Episodes.Title: The Toad, The Witch, and the Wardrobe
Episodes.Description: Wanda receives a clue from one of Magneto's minions, Pyro, directing her to a ski resort. Meanwhile, Kurt is meeting Amanda's parents for the first time, and the Toad believes he can use Kurt's holo-inducer to disguise himself and win Wanda's love.

Episodes.Title: Self Possessed
Episodes.Description: Rogue begins to lose control of all the people she's ever absorbed as they fight to take over. She discovers unsettling information about Mystique. Scott and Jean go on a date... or do they?

Episodes.Title: Under Lock and Key
Episodes.Description: Mesmero mentally controls Gambit into stealing half of the Spider Stone from Angel.

Episodes.Title: X23
Episodes.Description: A mysterious female assassin terrorizes the X-Mansion, knocking out the X-Men one by one. Wolverine finds out that it is his clone, created by the Dr. Deborah Risman and raised without love by HYDRA, and she wants to kill him because she holds him responsible for her miserable life. Wolverine and X-23, as she is called, square off in a battle that Wolverine does not want to win.

Episodes.Title: Dark Horizon (1)
Episodes.Description: As Jean's and Scott's graduation day approaches, Rogue suddenly leaves the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Dark Horizon (2)
Episodes.Description: As all the monsters in the tomb attack, the teammates fight to survive and find a way out.

Episodes.Title: Cruise Control
Episodes.Description: The X-Men are on vacation with Storm as their guardian. Amara falls ill while on the ship.

Episodes.Title: Impact
Episodes.Description: The X-Men pursue Apocalypse in Mexico, hoping to find and overcome him before Magneto finds him.

Episodes.Title: No Good Deed
Episodes.Description: The Brotherhood cause mishaps so they can stop them and appear to be heroes.

Episodes.Title: Target X
Episodes.Description: Wolverine finds his clone, X-23, who's trying to destroy Hydra, her creator, and the two team up to complete the mission.

Episodes.Title: Sins of the Son
Episodes.Description: Xavier is told he has a son, who has been kidnapped in Scotland. So he and the X-Men head there to find him.

Episodes.Title: Uprising
Episodes.Description: Hate crimes against mutants in Bayville prompt Spyke to return to stop the violence.

Episodes.Title: Cajun Spice
Episodes.Description: Rogue is kidnapped by Gambit, who says he's there to help her; and the X-Men search for her, led by Wolverine.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance
Episodes.Description: Kitty is rescued by a mutant and invites her to join the institute. But the mutant soon vanishes, and only Kitty remembers her.

Episodes.Title: Ascension (1)
Episodes.Description: Xavier finds Apocalypse in Egypt, and Apocalypse unleashes four horsemen, who battle the X-Men.

Episodes.Title: Ascension (2)
Episodes.Description: The battle against Apocalypse rages as X-Men, the Brotherhood, and Acolytes join forces to stop him from turning all humans into mutants.

Entries.Title: Batman: The Animated Series
Entries.Description: Catwoman steals a necklace to finance the purchase of land for a mountain lion reserve, but is stopped by a group of terrorists.

Episodes.Title: The Cat and the Claw (1)
Episodes.Description: Catwoman steals a necklace to finance the purchase of land for a mountain lion reserve, but is stopped by a group of terrorists.

Episodes.Title: On Leather Wings
Episodes.Description: When a vicious bat creature known as Man-Bat, starts terrorizing Gotham City, everyone mistakenly thinks that Batman is the culprit. Batman must find out who the mysterious Man-Bat is and clear his own name.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Ice
Episodes.Description: Brilliant cryogenics expert Dr. Victor Fries is transformed into Mr. Freeze, a vengeful creature who can only survive in subzero temperatures.

Episodes.Title: Feat of Clay (1)
Episodes.Description: A popular actor renowned for his ability to play any part has a terrible secret—he's addicted to a strange chemical formula that enables him to alter his facial features without makeup.

Episodes.Title: Feat of Clay (2)
Episodes.Description: Clayface learns that the man responsible for his disfigurement is to appear on TV, promoting a skin conditioner containing the same chemical that deformed him.

Episodes.Title: It's Never Too Late
Episodes.Description: An aging mob boss learns his drug dealings have contributed to his son's drug addiction.

Episodes.Title: Joker's Favor
Episodes.Description: When a timid accountant accidentally runs afoul of the Joker, he promises the Joker anything if the villain will only let him go.

Episodes.Title: The Cat and the Claw (2)
Episodes.Description: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

Episodes.Title: Pretty Poison
Episodes.Description: When District Attorney Harvey Dent is poisoned after a dinner date, Batman makes the horrifying discovery that his date was Poison Ivy, a plant-obsessed villainess.

Episodes.Title: Nothing to Fear
Episodes.Description: A horrifying villain named Scarecrow spreads fear gas and wreaks havoc at Gotham State University.

Episodes.Title: Be a Clown
Episodes.Description: The Joker infiltrates the birthday party of Mayor Hill's son in order to plant a bomb.

Episodes.Title: Appointment in Crime Alley
Episodes.Description: Batman's friend, Dr. Leslie Thompkins, is taken prisoner by a ruthless land developer after she uncovers his devious plans.

Episodes.Title: P.O.V.
Episodes.Description: Bullock's account of a botched sting operation is so at odds with the other officers' testimony that the police investigator suspends everyone involved.

Episodes.Title: The Clock King
Episodes.Description: When a maniacally punctilious man faces financial ruin because of attorney Hamilton Hill, he transforms into the devious Clock King and swears revenge on Hill, now the mayor of Gotham.

Episodes.Title: The Last Laugh
Episodes.Description: The Joker employs a lethal mind-altering laughing gas to transform the citizens of Gotham into total fools.

Episodes.Title: Eternal Youth
Episodes.Description: Alfred and his friend, Maggie Paige, visit a health spa that is actually run by the nefarious Poison Ivy.

Episodes.Title: Two-Face (1)
Episodes.Description: District Attorney Harvey Dent hides a deep dark secret—he has a second personality, Big Bad Harv, a tough gangster.

Episodes.Title: Two-Face (2)
Episodes.Description: Two-Face, the former Harvey Dent, begins an aggressive campaign against his hated rival, Rupert Thorne.

Episodes.Title: Fear of Victory
Episodes.Description: The Scarecrow uses a fear chemical triggered by adrenaline on Gotham's greatest athletes, then bets against them to reap the winnings.

Episodes.Title: I've Got Batman in My Basement
Episodes.Description: After the Penguin sprays Batman with nerve gas, a 12-year-old boy rescues the unconscious hero and hides him in his basement.

Episodes.Title: Vendetta
Episodes.Description: Batman suspects that an imprisoned Detective Bullock may be innocent after he is arrested for murder. The real murderer turns out to be Killer Croc, who framed Bullock to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: Prophecy of Doom
Episodes.Description: Bruce begins to worry when all of his wealthy friends join the same brotherhood group run by Nostromos, a so-called psychic.

Episodes.Title: The Forgotten
Episodes.Description: When men begin disappearing at a bowery, Bruce Wayne decides to go undercover as a worker. He loses his memory after he is attacked, kidnapped and forced to work in a mining camp.

Episodes.Title: Mad as a Hatter
Episodes.Description: The Mad Hatter puts the city of Gotham under his control in an attempt to impress a woman, Alice, with whom he is in love.

Episodes.Title: The Cape and Cowl Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: Batman investigates a theft of bearer bonds intended for the starving people of a poor country.

Episodes.Title: Perchance to Dream
Episodes.Description: Bruce Wayne wakes up to find that his parents are not dead, he is not Batman, and he's engaged to Selina Kyle.

Episodes.Title: The Underdwellers
Episodes.Description: Batman discovers a gang of forgotten runaways living deep within the Gotham sewer system.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Ninja
Episodes.Description: When Wayne Enterprises is robbed by a mysterious figure known as the Ninja, Batman and Robin discover that the Ninja is an old nemesis of Bruce Wayne.

Episodes.Title: The Strange Secret of Bruce Wayne
Episodes.Description: Dr. Hugo Strange's invention, a machine that reads people's thoughts, leads him to discover that Bruce Wayne is Batman.

Episodes.Title: Tyger, Tyger
Episodes.Description: When a genetic engineer produces a man-cat hybrid, he kidnaps Selina Kyle to provide his creation with a mate.

Episodes.Title: Dreams in Darkness
Episodes.Description: Batman must thwart the Scarecrow's plan to poison Gotham's water supply with a chemical that induces hallucinations.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Gray Ghost
Episodes.Description: Batman connects recent bombings in Gotham to an episode of an old television series featuring his favorite boyhood hero, the 'Gray Ghost.'

Episodes.Title: Cat Scratch Fever
Episodes.Description: Selina Kyle uncovers a plot to infect stray animals with a deadly disease that will be transmitted to the human population.

Episodes.Title: I Am the Night
Episodes.Description: On the anniversary of the death of Bruce Wayne's parents, Batman expresses doubts about whether or not he should continue his one-man war against crime.

Episodes.Title: Almost Got 'Im
Episodes.Description: While hiding from the police, Batman's deadliest enemies exchange stories about their mutual nemesis—Batman.

Episodes.Title: Moon of the Wolf
Episodes.Description: Professor Milo tries to use an old friend of Bruce Wayne's, Anthony Romulus, to destroy him after Milo injects Romulus with a serum that changes him into a wolf.

Episodes.Title: Terror in the Sky
Episodes.Description: When a man-sized bat ransacks Gotham harbor, Batman suspects that Dr. Kirk Langstrom is drinking his Man-Bat formula again.

Episodes.Title: Christmas with the Joker
Episodes.Description: The Joker kidnaps three prominent citizens during Christmas and challenges Batman to find him before midnight.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Steel (1)
Episodes.Description: Karl Rossum, owner of Cyberton Labs has been replacing important authority figures with robot look-alikes. Batman invites a young woman to dinner, not knowing that she is a robot as well.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Steel (2)
Episodes.Description: Batman escapes from being attacked by his own Batcomputer, which was sabatoged by HARDAC. He now seeks to get back Gordon, Hill and Bullock, who have all been replaced with robots.

Episodes.Title: If You're So Smart, Why Aren't You Rich?
Episodes.Description: When genius Edward Nygma's greedy boss unjustly fires him, Nygma seeks revenge as the Riddler.

Episodes.Title: Joker's Wild
Episodes.Description: When a billionaire builds a casino called the Joker's Wild, the Joker breaks out of Arkham Asylum to destroy it.

Episodes.Title: His Silicon Soul
Episodes.Description: A confused robot that believes he is Batman causes problems for the real Dark Knight.

Episodes.Title: Off Balance
Episodes.Description: Batman investigates a notorious global crime cartel, The Society of Shadows, which has begun to operate in Gotham City.

Episodes.Title: What Is Reality?
Episodes.Description: To prove that he has a superior mind, the Riddler lures Batman into a contest inside a virtual reality computer game.

Episodes.Title: The Laughing Fish
Episodes.Description: The Joker becomes enraged when the Gotham copyright office rejects his demand for a copyright for his grinning Joker fish.

Episodes.Title: Harley and Ivy
Episodes.Description: Harley Quinn has broken off with the Joker and teams up with Poison Ivy. Together they wreck havoc on Gotham and now Joker wants a piece of the action.

Episodes.Title: The Mechanic
Episodes.Description: While engaged in a high-speed chase, the Penguin's gang escapes and the Batmobile is virtually demolished.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Killed Batman
Episodes.Description: Sidney Debris, a small-time mobster, earns the hatred of all of Batman's enemies when he claims to have accidentally killed Batman during a brawl.

Episodes.Title: Zatanna
Episodes.Description: When glamorous female magician Zatanna is framed for a robbery during her act, Batman comes to her defense.

Episodes.Title: Robin's Reckoning (1)
Episodes.Description: After learning the name of an extortion ringleader, Batman mysteriously refuses to let Robin continue the investigation with him.

Episodes.Title: Birds of a Feather
Episodes.Description: Veronica Vreeland, a socialite desperate to create a novel party, makes the mistake of inviting the Penguin as her guest of honor.

Episodes.Title: Robin's Reckoning (2)
Episodes.Description: Despite Batman's orders not to, Robin pursues Tony Zucco, the criminal who was responsible for the death of Robin's parents.

Episodes.Title: Blind as a Bat
Episodes.Description: Bruce Wayne is temporarily blinded when the Penguin steals a new police helicopter with weaponry developed by WayneTech.

Episodes.Title: Day of the Samurai
Episodes.Description: Bruce Wayne and Alfred travel to Japan to help Bruce's old martial arts teacher, Sensei Yoru.

Episodes.Title: See No Evil
Episodes.Description: After a fortune disappears from a gem exposition, Batman investigates. He discovers that the crime may have been committed by an invisible man, an ex-con named Lloyd Ventris.

Episodes.Title: The Demon's Quest (1)
Episodes.Description: When Robin is mysteriously abducted, Batman's search leads him to meet Ra's Al Ghul, leader of The Society of Shadows, whose daughter, Talia, has also been kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: The Demon's Quest (2)
Episodes.Description: Batman discovers Ra's Al Ghul's plan to flood the Earth with chemicals and return it to a lush, green planet, destroying all existing life in the process.

Episodes.Title: Read My Lips
Episodes.Description: Batman investigates a series of baffling crimes and discovers that the crime czar is a wooden dummy, manipulated by a mild-mannered man called the Ventriloquist.

Episodes.Title: Fire from Olympus
Episodes.Description: Believing he's the reincarnation of Zeus, a mad shipping magnate mounts a stolen electron cannon atop his penthouse to shoot 'lightning bolts' at the 'wicked mortals' below.

Episodes.Title: Shadow of the Bat (1)
Episodes.Description: Commissioner Gordon is rumored to be taking bribes from Rupert Thorne. His daughter Barbara sets out to prove that he's innocent.

Episodes.Title: Shadow of the Bat (2)
Episodes.Description: Robin, who discovers that Gil Mason is in league with a powerful crime boss, encounters Batgirl as she tries to clear her father's name.

Episodes.Title: Mudslide
Episodes.Description: When Clayface's clay-like body begins to disintegrate, he is forced to steal to pay for the expensive ingredients of a possible remedy.

Episodes.Title: The Worry Men
Episodes.Description: Wealthy socialite Veronica Vreeland returns from Central America bringing tiny handmade dolls for all her friends—but the dolls are controlled by the Mad Hatter.

Episodes.Title: Paging the Crime Doctor
Episodes.Description: Crime boss Rupert Thorne forces his older brother, a doctor, to perform delicate surgery on Rupert—and kidnaps Dr. Leslie Thompkins to assist.

Episodes.Title: House & Garden
Episodes.Description: Poison Ivy appears to have stopped her crime spree when she marries a doctor with two sons to raise. However, crimes continue occurring in the Poison Ivy style, leaving Batman to question her innocence.

Episodes.Title: Sideshow
Episodes.Description: Killer Croc escapes when being transported to prison and hides out with a group of circus people.

Episodes.Title: Avatar
Episodes.Description: Ra's Al Ghul steals a sacred Egyptian scroll that Bruce Wayne donated to the Gotham museum.

Episodes.Title: Trial
Episodes.Description: All of Batman's enemies team together to put Batman on trial and send him to Arkham Asylum.

Episodes.Title: Harlequinade
Episodes.Description: Harley Quinn agrees to help Batman and Robin find the location of a stolen atomic bomb placed somewhere in Gotham by the Joker.

Episodes.Title: Bane
Episodes.Description: Rupert Thorne hires the chemically-augmented assassin Bane to kill Batman.

Episodes.Title: Second Chance
Episodes.Description: Batman and Robin are puzzled by the sudden kidnapping of Two-Face, who was on his way to have his face fixed.

Episodes.Title: Riddler's Reform
Episodes.Description: The Riddler appears to have gone straight when he develops a new and successful puzzle based toy.

Episodes.Title: Baby-Doll
Episodes.Description: Baby-Doll, a former child star, pours out her frustrations on her TV family by kidnapping them and holding them hostage.

Episodes.Title: Time Out of Joint
Episodes.Description: The Clock King plots against Mayor Hill after he steals an invention that allows him to travel at super speed.

Episodes.Title: Harley's Holiday
Episodes.Description: Harley gets herself into a whole mess of trouble after she steals Bruce Wayne's car and kidnaps his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Make 'Em Laugh
Episodes.Description: Batman and Robin investigate a string of crimes committed by a group of famous comedians brainwashed by the Joker.

Episodes.Title: Batgirl Returns
Episodes.Description: Batgirl and Catwoman team up to investigate the theft of a rare cat statue.

Episodes.Title: Lock-Up
Episodes.Description: Lyle Bolton, Arkham's former chief of security, becomes the vigilante Lock-Up and kidnaps Commissioner Gordon and Mayor Hill, seeing them as the cause of rampant crime in Gotham City.

Episodes.Title: Deep Freeze
Episodes.Description: Aging billionaire Grant Walker breaks Mr. Freeze out of prison so he can use the scientist's knowledge to can gain immortality and cover the world in a new ice age.

Episodes.Title: The Terrible Trio
Episodes.Description: Batman tracks three wealthy playboys who commit crimes out of boredom.

Episodes.Title: Showdown
Episodes.Description: Batman and Robin learn about the exploits of Jonah Hex, an Old West crimefighter who once dealt with the immortal Ra's Al Ghul.

Episodes.Title: Catwalk
Episodes.Description: Catwoman's attempt to go straight runs into problems when she is enticed into one last job by the Ventriloquist.

Episodes.Title: A Bullet for Bullock
Episodes.Description: Batman helps Detective Harvey Bullock who appears to be the target of someone's revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Lion and the Unicorn
Episodes.Description: Alfred, a former British spy, is called into duty and becomes of the target of the Red Claw.

Entries.Title: X-Men
Entries.Description: A young teenager has been rejecting her mutant powers ever since she discovered them. But when giant robots track her down, it's up to the X-Men to save her.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Sentinels (1)
Episodes.Description: A young teenager has been rejecting her mutant powers ever since she discovered them. But when giant robots track her down, it's up to the X-Men to save her.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Sentinels (2)
Episodes.Description: Breaking into the Mutant Control Agency's headquarters to destroy the registration files on mutants, the X-Men lose two of their members against the Sentinels, but eventually gain another.

Episodes.Title: Enter Magneto
Episodes.Description: As the Beast faces an arraignment in court before a mutant-hating public, the X-Men unwillingly take in an old enemy of Wolverine's. Magneto, an old friend turned enemy of Professor Xavier's, attacks a military base in an attempt to unite mutants against humanity.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Reunions
Episodes.Description: Magneto & Professor Xavier come face to face for the first time in years amid an exploding factory, while Sabretooth & Wolverine face off in the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Captive Hearts
Episodes.Description: Wolverine must overcome his feelings for Jean, and Storm must overcome her crippling claustrophobia, when the team journeys into the sewer to rescue Jean Grey & Cyclops from a race of hideously deformed mutants known as Morlocks, and their leader Callisto, who wants to make Scott her king.

Episodes.Title: Cold Vengeance
Episodes.Description: Having left the X-Men to seek peace in the arctic, Wolverine instead finds himself battling Sabretooth for the safety of an Inuit tribe. Storm, Gambit, and Jubilee investigate an island resort which welcomes mutants, and might be too good to be true.

Episodes.Title: Slave Island
Episodes.Description: Gambit, Storm, and Jubilee become slave labor on the island resort of Genosha, along with other mutants, forced to help build the new power source for a Sentinel factory. They're given aide in escaping by a mysterious mercenary named Cable.

Episodes.Title: The Unstoppable Juggernaut
Episodes.Description: The X-Men return from Genosha, finding the home destroyed, and Professor Xavier missing. They suspect a super-strong Russian mutant named Colossus, but the real culprit turns out to be someone more human, far tougher, and with deeper ties to the Professor.

Episodes.Title: The Cure
Episodes.Description: Rogue seeks a scientist who claims to be able to "cure" any mutant of their powers, unaware that neither he, nor his process, are what they appear to be.

Episodes.Title: Come the Apocalypse
Episodes.Description: An ancient and immensely powerful mutant, known as Apocalypse, creates four Horsemen to help usher in a new world where survival of the fittest reigns.

Episodes.Title: Days of Future Past (1)
Episodes.Description: A mutant from more than half a century into the future, named Bishop, arrives in the present, attempting to change history for the better, by stopping an X-Man from committing an assassination. But between being chased by a future breed of Sentinel, and the details of his mission being fuzzy, he's got his work cut out for him.

Episodes.Title: Days of Future Past (2)
Episodes.Description: Aware of an impending assassination which will create a catastrophic future, the X-Men must deal with threats both outside and within their team.

Episodes.Title: The Final Decision
Episodes.Description: Prominent anti-mutant and presidential hopeful Senator Kelly is caught in a tug-of-war between Magneto's goal of mutant superiority, the X-Men's dream of peaceful co-existance between mutants and humans, and the mutant-hunting Sentinel robots' goals of global domination.

Episodes.Title: The Return
Episodes.Description: When a young girl named Hisako Ichiki goes missing in northern Japan, her parents seek help in Professor Xavier, who calls on the X-Men to unite.

Episodes.Title: U-Men
Episodes.Description: The X-Men carry out an investigation that leads them to the U-Men, a group of mad scientists whose hideout contains a horrifying secret.

Episodes.Title: Armor
Episodes.Description: Hisako's mutant powers are weakened during a fierce battle between the X-Men and Todd, the U-Men's mad scientist.

Episodes.Title: Transformation
Episodes.Description: The X-Men are put at risk of secondary mutation when the Blackbird is attacked by a bat-like creature showing dangerous signs of Damon-Hall Syndrome.

Episodes.Title: Power
Episodes.Description: Emma allows Professor Xavier to read her mind and reveal her thoughts after Cyclops opposes her membership in the X-Men.

Episodes.Title: Conflict
Episodes.Description: An intense battle ensues when the X-Men are attacked by remnants of the U-Men after being forced to execute an emergency landing in the Blackbird.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Having defeated the U-Men, the X-Men come face to face with Yui Sasaki at her underground base, where she once ran a school for mutant children.

Episodes.Title: Lost
Episodes.Description: After falling ill with Damon-Hall Syndrome, Riko and Kaga attack the X-men's base, while Emma spies on a stranger in her diamond form.

Episodes.Title: Revelations
Episodes.Description: Revelations abound when it's discovered that Riko and Kaga were drugged by Yui and that Jun and Mastermind are one in the same.

Episodes.Title: Countdown
Episodes.Description: Mastermind's evil plans are frustrated as a fierce battle between the X-Men and the Four Pillars of the Inner Circle rages on.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Despite Yui's attempts to suppress them, Takeo's powers continue to gain strength, causing reality itself to become more and more twisted.

Episodes.Title: Destiny
Episodes.Description: The X-Men mount an attack to bring down Professor Xavier's son, Takeo, before he destroys the world, putting an end to both mutants and humanity.

Episodes.Title: Till Death Do Us Part (1)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men are divided and conquered, by none other than a friend they had thought dead.

Episodes.Title: Till Death Do Us Part (2)
Episodes.Description: As Morph's seeking of revenge on the X-Men begins to run into some snags, Cyclops & Jean Grey get their Honeymoon cut short by the machinations of Mister Sinister and the Nasty Boys.

Episodes.Title: Whatever It Takes
Episodes.Description: Storm returns to her village in Africa, and must choose between her life and that of her godson when a powerful evil overtakes him. Meanwhile, Wolverine tracks down Morph in the Amazon, and Professor Xavier & Magneto find their situation going from bad to worse as they end up in a hidden land.

Episodes.Title: Red Dawn
Episodes.Description: Jubilee joins Colossus as he returns to his homeland of Russia, and helps him face an unbeatable menace from the Cold War, who wishes to restore the former Soviet Union, and has a history with Wolverine.

Episodes.Title: Repo Man
Episodes.Description: Wolverine is led back to his homeland of Canada, and is attacked by his former teammates from the supergroup Alpha Flight. The government wants the secrets of his adamantium skeleton back, and are willing to take him apart to get it.

Episodes.Title: X-Ternally Yours
Episodes.Description: Gambit must come face to face with the past he's been running from for years, as he returns to Louisiana to save his brother from the woman he left at the altar.

Episodes.Title: Time Fugitives (1)
Episodes.Description: Bishop returns from the future to again attempt to fix his world, this time trying to stop a plague from infecting mutants. But his noble actions lead to a far greater tragedy.

Episodes.Title: Time Fugitives (2)
Episodes.Description: To stablize his own timeline, Cable comes to the present to prevent Bishop from saving mutant-kind from Apocalypse's plague.

Episodes.Title: A Rogue's Tale
Episodes.Description: Haunted by visions of a strange woman, Rogue must come to grips with the dark secrets of her past prior to joining the X-Men.

Episodes.Title: Beauty & the Beast
Episodes.Description: Beast falls in love with his patient, a blind woman named Carly, and though the feelings are mutual, her mutant-hating father and anti-mutant sentiment drive a split between the pair. Meanwhile, Wolverine seeks to take down the Friends of Humanity from the inside out.

Episodes.Title: Mojovision
Episodes.Description: An alien being named Mojo abducts the X-Men to use as forced action stars of television programming.

Episodes.Title: Reunion (1)
Episodes.Description: Professor Xavier and Magneto gain a native ally, as they finally come face to face with the new ruler of the Savage Land. A lead from Morph sets up a rematch between Wolverine, Cyclops, Jean Grey and Mister Sinister & his Nasty Boys.

Episodes.Title: Reunion (2)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men find themselves powerless in the Savage Land, and become fodder for Mr. Sinister's experiments. It's up to Wolverine and Ka-Zar to initiate a rescue.

Episodes.Title: Out of the Past (1)
Episodes.Description: A group of cyborg mercenaries, led by a woman from Wolverine's past, seek his forced help in unlocking the secrets of a long buried alien spacecraft.

Episodes.Title: Out of the Past (2)
Episodes.Description: An alien being called the Spirit Drinker drains the life-force of Jubilee and the Reavers, making strained allies of Wolverine and Lady Deathstrike.

Episodes.Title: The Phoenix Saga: Sacrifice (1)
Episodes.Description: Following visions from recent dreams, Professor Xavier sends his X-Men on a mission to the Eagle One Space-Station, putting them in the middle of an interstellar conflict.

Episodes.Title: The Phoenix Saga: The Dark Shroud (2)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men barely survive their return trip from space, Jean Grey discovering herself changed by the experience. Professor Xavier's dark half is given form, and proceeds to attack his students.

Episodes.Title: The Phoenix Saga: Cry of the Banshee (3)
Episodes.Description: Professor Xavier's claims of the capture of his alien soulmate Lilandra by Juggernaut and Black Tom Cassidy are met with skepticism.

Episodes.Title: The Phoenix Saga: The Starjammers (4)
Episodes.Description: Lilandra seeks to protect the M'Kraan Crystal from her wicked brother, the Emperor D'Ken. But the interstellar pirates known as the Starjammers capture it, and Cyclops, in an effort to enact their own revenge scheme on the emperor.

Episodes.Title: The Phoenix Saga: Child of Light (5)
Episodes.Description: Shi'ar Emperor D'Ken's rise to power via the M'Kraan Crystal is causing a universal implosion. The X-Men, Imperial Guard, and Starjammers find themselves overpowered and unable to stop it. Jean Grey must unleash her destiny as the host of the Phoenix, even at a most personal cost.

Episodes.Title: Savage Land, Strange Heart (1)
Episodes.Description: Mutant-draining, pterodactyl-man Sauron is persuaded into capturing Storm by Zaladane, the high priestess of Savage Land Sun God Garokk, unaware of her ulterior motives for unleashing the mutant's full potential.

Episodes.Title: Savage Land, Strange Heart (2)
Episodes.Description: Storm's unfettered weather-fury continues setting the stage for the rise of Garokk. Even if Storm can be brought back under control, the Sun God's geothermal rejuvenation will spell an end to the Antarctic paradise known as the Savage Land.

Episodes.Title: Obsession
Episodes.Description: Fueled on by his desire to seek vengeance against the immortal mutant that changed him into a weapon of evil, Archangel persaudes Rogue into helping him hunt down and destroy Apocalypse.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Phoenix: Dazzled (1)
Episodes.Description: The flirtation between Cyclops and a mutant singer named Dazzler exacerbates the Phoenix-controlled side of Jean Grey, leaving her open for manipulation by a secret sect of mutants coveting her immense powers for their own evil designs.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Phoenix: The Inner Circle (2)
Episodes.Description: The Circle Club makes the Phoenix-controlled Jean Grey their new Queen, but finds two factors opposing it: her mental bond with Cyclops, and the presumed-dead Wolverine stalking after them.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Phoenix: The Dark Phoenix (3)
Episodes.Description: As the Dark Phoenix grows increasingly hostile, even destroying an entire star system, the X-Men struggle to figure out a way to stop her without harming their teammate Jean Grey.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Phoenix: The Fate of the Phoenix (4)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men face the Shi'ar Imperial Guard in a trial by combat to spare the life of Jean Grey, though even they begin to question the safety of the universe as long as the Dark Phoenix remains alive inside her.

Episodes.Title: Cold Comfort
Episodes.Description: A founding member of the X-Men, named Iceman, breaks into a government facility. He refuses to trust his former teammates about his reasons for doing so, but when Jubilee aids him in his quest, it leads to the team going up against another group of mutants, known as X-Factor.

Episodes.Title: Orphan's End
Episodes.Description: Cyclops discovers that Corsair, the leader of the interstellar band of pirates known as the Starjammers, is his father. He's a fugitive on the run from the Shi'ar empire, and seeks his help in proving his innocence. But can the man who abandoned him as a child truly be trusted?

Episodes.Title: The Juggernaut Returns
Episodes.Description: Professor Xavier's step-brother, and sworn enemy, the Juggernaut loses his powers to a bumbling archeologist. He must overcome the pain of their childhood together, and have the powers restored to him to save his life.

Episodes.Title: Nightcrawler
Episodes.Description: Gambit, Rogue, and Wolverine take a ski trip in Germany. While Gambit and Rogue seem to be enjoying themselves, Wolverine is restless, and longs for some action. When he hears reports of a demon hiding in a local monastery, his investigation reveals not a demon, but a mutant, Nightcrawler, whose devilish appearance is in stark contrast to his peaceful and deeply philosophical nature.

Episodes.Title: Weapon X, Lies, and Video Tape
Episodes.Description: A cryptic postcard unleashes a flood of maddening and painful memories in Wolverine that threaten to drive him insane. To keep his mind from being torn apart, Wolverine and Beast travel to the one location that may hold the answers to his hidden past: the ruins of the top-secret Weapon X lab where Wolverine's bones were laced with adamantium. There he encounters other former 'test subjects'—Sabretooth, Maverick and Silver Fox—who are suffering similar mental breakdowns.

Episodes.Title: One Man's Worth (1)
Episodes.Description: Bishop & Shard recruit Wolverine & Storm for a time travel mission to save Professor Xavier's life. Except they're from the parallel timeline where he died before founding the X-Men, a world where humans and mutants are in a constant war with one another. Not only do they pair lack a connection to him, but correcting history may put an end to their marriage.

Episodes.Title: One Man's Worth (2)
Episodes.Description: Bishop, Shard, and the alternate-present versions of Wolverine & Storm, will have one more chance to save Xavier from being killed before he founded the X-Men... if they can survive the alternate-future ruled entirely unopposed by Mastermold.

Episodes.Title: Courage
Episodes.Description: Morph feels he's finally ready to return to the X-Men. But his homecoming is interrupted by the return of the Sentinels, the robotic mutant-hunters who nearly killed him the last time he faced them. Will history repeat itself?

Episodes.Title: Proteus (1)
Episodes.Description: The long hidden secret patient of Muir Island, a reality-warping mutant teen known as Proteus, escapes from his 15 year long captivity, and wreaks havoc across Scotland searching out his father.

Episodes.Title: Proteus (2)
Episodes.Description: Tracking down his father, who is now a candidate for Secretary of State, Proteus continues threatening lives with his uncontrolable powers. It's up to Professor X alone to try to stop the boy who brought even Wolverine to his knees.

Episodes.Title: Sanctuary (1)
Episodes.Description: Magneto builds a home strictly for mutants on the orbiting base known as Asteroid M. The message goes out worldwide of initial exodus, and he finds just as many eager to join him, as those anxious to destroy him.

Episodes.Title: Sanctuary (2)
Episodes.Description: With Magneto seemingly dead, Fabian Cortez takes over Asteroid M, and initiates a nuclear war with Earth. The X-Men attempt to sabotage his warhead stockpile, and rescue Gambit, finding assistance in the most unlikely of places.

Episodes.Title: Beyond Good and Evil (1)
Episodes.Description: Apocalypse steals Cable's computer in the year 3999, allowing him to time travel to the past, where he schemes to bring an end to his struggle against inferior mutants once and for all. This leads to Bishop becoming trapped amid the timestream, and brings

Episodes.Title: Beyond Good and Evil (2)
Episodes.Description: When Oracle, the psychic member of the Imperial Guard is kidnapped by Apocalypse, Professor Xavier deduces his scheme involves capturing mutants with telepathic abilities. The X-Men are split up to track them down before the villains can, which puts Wolverine & Shard in the middle of a scuffle between Archangel and a ninja named Psylocke.

Episodes.Title: Beyond Good and Evil (3)
Episodes.Description: After swiping the government's own time machine, Cable ends up recruiting the X-Men on his mission to destroy Apocalypse's source of immortality at its creation.

Episodes.Title: Beyond Good and Evil (4)
Episodes.Description: Two of Apocalypse's former evil allies, the captive Wolverine, the loose cannon Cable, and the exiled Bishop, come together to free the kidnapped psychics and save reality from being rewritten.

Episodes.Title: Have Yourself a Morlock Little X-Mas
Episodes.Description: Jubilee's first Christmas with the X-Men doesn't go exactly as she expected, when she, Storm, and Wolverine become involved with a mission to save the Morlock child known as Leech.

Episodes.Title: The Lotus and the Steel
Episodes.Description: Finding himself continually losing control, Wolverine takes a sabbatical to Japan, in an effort to find inner peace in temple-building. Instead, he faces a village under siege by a group of bandits, and struggles to help them without compromising his search for his true nature.

Episodes.Title: Love in Vain
Episodes.Description: In a New Mexico desert, Wolverine witnesses the crash of a spaceship carrying horrific, alien bug-like creatures—the Family—which overwhelm him. Rogue reunites with her first boyfriend, Cody, who ends up being a part of the Family's plot to have Rogue become their new leader.

Episodes.Title: Secrets, Not Long Buried
Episodes.Description: Cyclops heads solo to the desert town of Skull Mesa, where humans and mutants live in harmony, to visit an old mentor from his youth. But he not only finds himself powerless when he arrives, but discovers the place under the rule of a maniacal mutant, with none of the citizens willing to take a stand.

Episodes.Title: Xavier Remembers
Episodes.Description: Trapped on the astral plane after suffering a concussion, Professor Xavier is at the mercy of the Shadow King, and in desperate need of help from his X-Men, who are unable to hear him.

Episodes.Title: Family Ties
Episodes.Description: X-Factor's Quicksilver, and his sister, the Avenger called Scarlet Witch, seek revenge against Magneto when they learn that he was responsible for their birth mother's death. But the trio is unaware of the common bond between them, nor the true purposes of the mysterious man who brought them all together.

Episodes.Title: The Phalanx Covenant (1)
Episodes.Description: Rushing to investigate a disturbance downtown, the X-Men find Sabretooth on the rampage again, but realize too late that it isn't really Sabretooth at all. It is the Phalanx, a voracious alien life-form that can assume the guise of anything or anyone. Before long, the X-Men are all captured, except for Beast, who must find a way to stop the alien horror from devouring the entire Earth.

Episodes.Title: The Phalanx Covenant (2)
Episodes.Description: Snatched from the jaws of the Phalanx by the villainous Mr. Sinister, Beast and Forge search for allies to help them battle the alien threat. Gathering assistance from such unlikely sources as Magneto and Sinister himself, they embark upon a daring and risky plan to free the planet from the clutches of the Phalanx by traveling straight into the belly of the beast.

Episodes.Title: A Deal with the Devil
Episodes.Description: The former Soviet Union's living weapon, Omega Red, is thawed out by the US Military to deal with an abandoned Soviet nuclear submarine near Hawaii. He asks for his old enemy, Wolverine, and the woman responsible for freezing him most recently, Storm, to accompany him on the mission. Omega Red is offered restored humanity, but once aboard the warhead-filled sub, he reveals his true, deadly intentions.

Episodes.Title: No Mutant Is an Island
Episodes.Description: Cyclops, still in mourning after Jean Grey's "death", quits the X-men and returns to his orphanage home and encounters his friend Sarah. She tells him that a wealthy man has decided to adopt all the mutant children, especially Rusty, but his intentions are to make them his army to destroy all humans in the world so that mutants are accepted. It's up to Cyclops to stop him and save the mutant children.

Episodes.Title: Longshot
Episodes.Description: Longshot, a rebel from another world, tumbles into this world with no memory and a murderous gang led by the six-armed woman warrior Spiral hot on his trail. It turns out that Longshot is on the run from Mojo, maniacal inter-dimensional TV executive. Using Jubilee as the 'prize', Mojo and his minions lure Longshot and the X-Men into a deadly contest which Mojo broadcasts 'live' to up his ratings.

Episodes.Title: Bloodlines
Episodes.Description: Nightcrawler gets a mysterious message. He is informed that his birth mother (whom he never knew) is in trouble. He turns to the X-Men for assistance. Jubilee is baffled that Nightcrawler wants to help the mother who abandoned him -- she has never known her birth parents and feels pretty hostile toward them, whoever they are. Nightcrawler admits there has been pain, but his faith in God has helped him overcome her rejection. The plot thickens when one of the team members recognizes Nightcrawler's mother's voice.

Episodes.Title: Storm Front (1)
Episodes.Description: The dashing alien, Arkon, unleashes terrible weather conditions over Washington D.C. to get Storm's attention. It works, he begs her to return with him to his planet, Corsus, to save it from meteorological chaos which threatens his people.

Episodes.Title: Storm Front (2)
Episodes.Description: Spectacular preparations for Storm's wedding to Arkon proceed quickly. But as Jubilee helps Storm, the new queen, prepare for the wedding, Jubilee can't help notice how badly the palace workers are treated. Meanwhile, Wolverine, Cyclops and Beast discover there are fleet ships bringing slaves from the neighboring planet.

Episodes.Title: Jubilee's Fairytale Theatre
Episodes.Description: Jubilee tells children her own fairy tale having herself, her fellow X-Men and their greatest enemies be the characters in it.

Episodes.Title: The Fifth Horseman
Episodes.Description: Fabian Cortez helps Apocalypse escape from the astral plane.

Episodes.Title: Old Soldiers
Episodes.Description: Wolverine thinks back to the time when he fought during World War II and teamed up with Captain America.

Episodes.Title: Descent
Episodes.Description: The origin of Mr. Sinister is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Agendas
Episodes.Description: When the army learns of Sam Guthrie's cannonball power, they try to enlist him in their ranks.

Episodes.Title: Graduation Day
Episodes.Description: At a Mutant/Human Relations Summit, Henry Peter Gyrich attacks.

Entries.Title: The Flash
Entries.Description: Barry discovers his powers and puts them to the test, only when he finds its no longer a test but the real thing when he encounters a certain someone.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Barry discovers his powers and puts them to the test, only when he finds its no longer a test but the real thing when he encounters a certain someone.

Episodes.Title: Fastest Man Alive
Episodes.Description: Barry changes into the Flash when six gunmen storm a university event honoring a scientist, but his heroics don't match up to his expectations. Meanwhile, Iris becomes even more intrigued by the "red streak."

Episodes.Title: Things You Can't Outrun
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team go after the Mist, who possesses toxic gas powers, and they reflect on the night Caitlin's fiancé died. Meanwhile, Henry gets a long-awaited visit from Joe, and Iris and Eddie continue to keep their romance a secret from Joe.

Episodes.Title: Going Rogue
Episodes.Description: The Flash battles Captain Cold after the villain is involved in a robbery and plots to steal the Kahndaq Dynasty Diamond.

Episodes.Title: Plastique
Episodes.Description: After a bomb explodes downtown, the army rolls in and takes over. When Joe learns Iris is writing about 'The Streak' and tries unsuccessfully to have the story stopped, Barry decides to have The Flash pay her a visit.

Episodes.Title: The Flash is Born
Episodes.Description: The Flash faces a new meta-human named Tony, who can turn himself into girded steel at will.

Episodes.Title: Power Outage
Episodes.Description: The Flash goes up against Farooq aka Blackout, a metahuman who can harness electricity.

Episodes.Title: Flash vs. Arrow (I)
Episodes.Description:
Barry is thrilled when Oliver, Felicity and Diggle come to Central City to investigate a case involving a deadly boomerang.

The crossover continues on Arrow S03E08 The Brave and the Bold.

Episodes.Title: The Man in the Yellow Suit
Episodes.Description: Barry enjoys the annual tradition of tree trimming and gift exchange with Joe and Iris. He gives Iris a touching gift, but the moment is interrupted by Eddie’s arrival.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Rogues
Episodes.Description: While Barry strives to become fast enough to defeat Reverse-Flash, Captain Cold returns to Central City with a partner and takes Caitlin hostage to force a confrontation with the Flash.

Episodes.Title: The Sound and the Fury
Episodes.Description: Dr. Wells' former protégé, Hartley Rathaway, returns to seek revenge on his mentor. Meanwhile, Iris is hired as a cub reporter; Cisco recalls his first day on the job at S.T.A.R. Labs; and Joe asks Eddie for a favor but asks him to keep it a secret from Barry.

Episodes.Title: Crazy for You
Episodes.Description: Caitlin takes Barry out to a local karaoke bar to help them both find new loves. Caitlin strikes out but Barry meets a sports reporter and asks her out for a date. Meanwhile, Cisco considers Hartley's dangerous offer; and the team search for Shawna, a meta-human with teleportation powers who just busted her boyfriend out of Iron Heights.

Episodes.Title: The Nuclear Man
Episodes.Description: While Barry, Harrison, and Caitlin hunt down Ronnie, who has attacked a man, Joe recruits Cisco to help him learn the truth about who murdered Nora Allen.

Episodes.Title: Fallout
Episodes.Description: Martin and Ronnie are separated, only to realize that they must learn how to rejoin before Eiling hunts them down and kills them... and the Flash. Meanwhile, Joe shows Barry the 3D images from the Nora Allen crime scene, and Barry asks Martin for advice on time travel.

Episodes.Title: Out of Time
Episodes.Description: Mark Mardon, having survived his apparent death during the black-matter explosion, returns seeking revenge on Joe for the death of his brother Clyde... and has the same weather-manipulation powers as his deceased sibling.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Time
Episodes.Description: The Flash learns that Captain Cold and Heat Wave have returned to Central City. This time Snart has brought along his baby sister Lisa to help wreak havoc on the city.

Episodes.Title: Tricksters
Episodes.Description: When a villain calling himself the Trickster runs rampant in Central City, Joe and Barry go to Iron Heights to talk with the original Trickster.

Episodes.Title: All Star Team Up
Episodes.Description: Felicity and Ray Palmer pay a visit to S.T.A.R. Labs for help getting Ray's ATOM suit to work, and ask Cisco for help. Meanwhile, a young tech expert raises havoc with her insect drones, and Barry asks Ray for help dealing with her.

Episodes.Title: Who Is Harrison Wells?
Episodes.Description: Joe and Cisco go to Starling City to ask Quentin Lance for his help investigating the site of Harrison's car accident 15 years ago and determining what really happened. Meanwhile, Eddie is framed for a shooting by a shapeshifing metahuman who can take on the appearance of anyone he touches.

Episodes.Title: The Trap
Episodes.Description: Barry, Caitlin, Cisco and Joe set a trap for Wells. Cisco uses himself as prey which puts him in grave danger. Meanwhile, Eddie makes a decision regarding Iris, which leaves Joe a bit unsettled.

Episodes.Title: Grodd Lives
Episodes.Description: While Barry tries to find Eddie, a mysterious mind-controlled thief launches attacks on Central City's gold reserves. The team soon discovers that a telepathic gorilla is behind the robberies... and is following Harrison's commands. Meanwhile, Iris confronts Barry, while Harrison prepares to return home.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Air
Episodes.Description: When Harrison activates the particle accelerator, the team has no choice but to evacuate the five metahuman prisoners. Unfortunately, with time running out, Barry has no choice but to turn to Captain Cold for help. Meanwhile, Eddie escapes but has some surprising news for Iris.

Episodes.Title: Fast Enough
Episodes.Description: Wells presents Barry with a life-changing choice. Dr. Martin Stein and Ronnie Raymond return to help the S.T.A.R. Labs team with this final fight.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Saved Central City
Episodes.Description: Picking up months after the Singularity attacked Central City, Barry is still struggling to forgive himself for Eddie’s death. Concerned about putting his friends in danger, Barry has pushed everyone away and has chosen to protect the city on his own. When a meta-human named Atom Smasher attacks the city, Iris tells Barry that he needs to let his friends help him protect the citizens of Central City. Meanwhile, Cisco helps Joe with his Meta Task Force.

Episodes.Title: Flash of Two Worlds
Episodes.Description: Jay Garrick, a mysterious man from Earth-2, appears at S.T.A.R. Labs with a dire warning about an evil speedster named Zoom, who is set on destroying The Flash. Barry and the team must decide if they can trust this stranger even as they face yet another powerful meta-human. Meanwhile, Joe must deal with a determined officer named Patty Spivot who wants to join his meta-human task force.

Episodes.Title: Family of Rogues
Episodes.Description: When Barry and the team find out Captain Cold has been kidnapped, they form an uneasy alliance with his sister, Lisa. However, Barry feels double-crossed when he finds out Snart is working with his father, Lewis Snart on a heist. Meanwhile, Joe is faced with a difficult decision.

Episodes.Title: The Fury of Firestorm
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team look for another Firestorm match for Dr. Stein. When the team meets Jefferson "Jax" Jackson, Caitlin has her reservations about whether Jax is the right match for Dr. Stein. Iris surprises Joe while Barry and Patty grow closer.

Episodes.Title: The Darkness and the Light
Episodes.Description: Barry learns a new breacher, Dr. Light, has come through the portal and sets off to capture her. Jay tells Barry that Dr. Light was not a threat on Earth-2 and that Barry can reason with her. However, during a fight with The Flash, she blinds him and drops some shocking news about Zoom. Meanwhile, Barry and Patty go out on a date.

Episodes.Title: Enter Zoom
Episodes.Description: After recent events, Barry decides it’s time to confront Zoom and comes up with a dangerous plan. Caitlin sides with Jay and deems it too dangerous for Barry to engage with the speed demon. However, Iris shows her support and brings forth a surprising ally. We see what Earth-2 Harrison Wells’ life was like before coming through the breech.

Episodes.Title: Gorilla Warfare
Episodes.Description: Grodd returns to Central City and kidnaps Caitlin. Barry and team race to find her before it’s too late. Meanwhile, Cisco plans his first date with the new barista at Jitters, Kendra Saunders and Patty begins to suspect Barry is hiding something from her.

Episodes.Title: Legends of Today (I)
Episodes.Description:
Vandal Savage arrives in Central City and sets his sights on Kendra Saunders. After Vandal attacks Kendra and Cisco, they turn to Barry for help. Realizing how dangerous Vandal is, Barry takes Kendra to Star City and asks Oliver and team to hide her until he can figure out how to stop Vandal. However, things quickly go from bad to worse when a man with wings AKA Hawkman shows up and flies off with Kendra. Meanwhile, Harrison develops a serum to make Barry run faster and asks Jay to test it out.

The crossover continues on Arrow S04E08 Legends of Yesterday (II).

Episodes.Title: Running to Stand Still
Episodes.Description: When Mark Mardon AKA The Weather Wizard returns to break Leonard Snart AKA Captain Cold and James Jesse AKA The Trickster out of Iron Heights, Barry must stop these rogues from taking over Central City during Christmas. Meanwhile, Joe and Iris meet Wally West.

Episodes.Title: Potential Energy
Episodes.Description: Now that they've grown closer, Barry considers telling Patty that he is The Flash. Meanwhile, Joe and Iris try to get to know Wally, and the team hunts down a meta-human who can slow time itself.

Episodes.Title: The Reverse-Flash Returns
Episodes.Description: When Cisco gets a vibe of Eobard Thawne, Barry and the team don’t believe it. But, after an attack at Mercury Labs, Christina McGee confirms that the Reverse Flash is back. Meanwhile, Iris and Francine share a nice moment that brings Iris closer to her brother, Wally.

Episodes.Title: Fast Lane
Episodes.Description: Barry teams up with Wells to figure out a way to close the breaches, but they are distracted by a meta-human nicknamed Tar Pit who can transform into liquid asphalt. Iris is concerned for Wally’s safety after she finds out about his drag racing hobby. When he refuses to stop she makes a bold move that puts her in danger.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Earth-2
Episodes.Description: Barry, Wells and Cisco journey to Earth-2 to rescue Wells’ daughter, Jesse from Zoom. Barry is stunned when he runs into Earth-2 Iris and Joe, but nothing prepares him for meeting Killer Frost and Deathstorm. Meanwhile, back on Earth-1, Jay has to take over the Flash’s responsibilities when a meta-human nicknamed Geomancer attacks Central City.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Earth-2
Episodes.Description: On Earth-2, the team races to find Zoom's lair and asks for help from the most unexpected source. Meanwhile, back on Earth-1, Caitlin rushes to perfect Velocity-9 so that Jay can stop the Geomancer.

Episodes.Title: King Shark
Episodes.Description: When King Shark escapes from an A.R.G.U.S. holding tank, Lyla and Diggle travel to Central City to warn The Flash. King Shark shows up at the West house and attacks Joe, Iris, Wally and Barry.

Episodes.Title: Trajectory
Episodes.Description: Having arrived in town intent on creating maximum chaos, Trajectory's antics are misinterpreted as having been perpetrated by the Flash himself. Barry thus must quickly uncover the mystery of who is the girl under the mask — as well as what is driving her mad desire for speed and destruction.

Episodes.Title: Flash Back
Episodes.Description: After the shocking revelation that Zoom is Jay Garrick, Barry is more determined than ever to get back to Earth-2 to stop Zoom forever. Desperate to find a way to increase his speed, Barry decides to travel back in time and masquerade as his earlier self in order to get his arch-nemesis, Dr. Harrison Wells/Eobard Thawne, to teach him how to run faster. However, things don’t go as planned and Barry is stunned to face familiar foe Hartley Rathaway, as well as old friend Eddie Thawne. Iris makes peace with her past in order to embrace her future.

Episodes.Title: Versus Zoom
Episodes.Description: Equipped with the tachyon device, Barry believes he is fast enough to stop Zoom and wants to open the breaches to catch him. Harry strongly advises against that plan but after Barry convinces him, Harry reveals that Cisco has the power to re-open the breach. Meanwhile, Hunter Zoloman’s painful story on Earth-2 is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Back to Normal
Episodes.Description: A meta-human with super strength named Griffin Grey mistakes Harry for Earth-1 Harrison Wells and kidnaps him, demanding that Wells cure him from his current condition. Realizing another brilliant Wells could help track Griffin’s location, Barry asks Jesse to help. Meanwhile, Wally corners Joe about The Flash.

Episodes.Title: Rupture
Episodes.Description: Zoom arrives back on Earth-1 intent on taking over Central City. Barry and Wells come up with a plan to stop Zoom once and for all but it’s extremely dangerous. Unsure if he should take the risk, Barry reaches out to both fathers for advice. Henry is adamantly opposed to Barry risking his life again but Joe thinks he can handle it which puts the two men at odds with each other. Meanwhile, Cisco is shocked when he vibes the Earth-2 villain Rupture, who happens to be his brother Dante’s doppelganger. Rupture came to this Earth seeking justice for Reverb’s death. Iris decides she’s finally ready to open up to Barry about her feelings for him.

Episodes.Title: The Runaway Dinosaur
Episodes.Description: With Barry gone, the team must figure out a way to handle the return of an old enemy - Girder. Realizing Girder is retracing his steps from his last attack, Iris volunteers to act as bait to trap him in S.T.A.R. Labs. Meanwhile, Barry fights to return to his old life.

Episodes.Title: Invincible
Episodes.Description: After Zoom unleashes an army of Earth-2 meta-humans on Central City, Barry is shaken when he sees their leader is the Black Canary’s Earth-2 doppelganger, the Black Siren. Meanwhile, Wally takes to the streets to help The Flash stop the meta-humans, which worries Joe. Iris and Henry are concerned about Barry taking on Zoom.

Episodes.Title: The Race of His Life
Episodes.Description: After Zoom reveals his true plan, Barry vows to do whatever it takes to stop him.

Episodes.Title: Flashpoint
Episodes.Description: Barry is living his dream life – his parents are alive, he’s asked Iris West on a date and he can finally be a normal guy as Central City has another speedster, Kid Flash, running around saving the city. When Barry starts forgetting parts of his old life, the Reverse Flash taunts his nemesis and tells him that there will be serious repercussions for Barry and the ones he loves if he continues to live in this alternate universe. In addition to losing his memories, his powers will also start to fade. When disaster strikes, Barry must decide if he wants to continue to live in this world as Barry Allen or return to his universe as The Flash.

Episodes.Title: Paradox
Episodes.Description: Barry realizes the effects from Flashpoint are much greater than he thought. Meanwhile, Barry meets new co-worker Julian Albert and is surprised by Julian's immediate disdain for him.

Episodes.Title: Magenta
Episodes.Description: Barry and Team Flash are thrilled to reunite with Earth-2  Wells and Jesse.  Wells  confides to Barry and Caitlin that Jesse has all  the powers of a speedster and has been saving people on his Earth.  He  is concerned about her safety and wants them to talk her out of using  her powers.  Meanwhile, Magenta, a new meta who  can control metal, terrorizes the city.

Episodes.Title: The New Rogues
Episodes.Description: Barry continues to train Jesse and when a new meta human, Mirror Master, appears on the scene he lets her tag along. Mirror Master has teamed up with his old partner, Top, and is looking for Snart to even a score. Jesse is quick to join the chase but defies one of Barry’s orders which results in disastrous consequences.

Episodes.Title: Monster
Episodes.Description: Caitlin goes to her mother to help understand the meta-human powers growing inside her. Meanwhile Barry tries to convince Julian to allow him to help investigate a new human meta-attack on Central City.

Episodes.Title: Shade
Episodes.Description: When Wally starts having dreams about being Kid Flash, Barry realizes he has to tell Wally, Iris and Joe about what happened to Wally in Flashpoint in order to keep him safe.

Episodes.Title: Killer Frost
Episodes.Description: Caitlin uses her powers to save Barry but as her mother predicted, the effort unleashes her inner Killer Frost. Killer Frost goes on a rampage looking for Dr. Alchemy, kidnapping Julian and battling both The Flash and Vibe. Meanwhile, Joe and H.R. have a heart to heart talk.

Episodes.Title: Invasion! (II)
Episodes.Description:
When aliens called the Dominators attack Central City, Barry speeds over to Star City to ask the Green Arrow for help in stopping them. Realizing the battle against the Dominators is bigger than they thought, they track down the Legends of Tomorrow, and Barry and Cisco create a breach to bring back a secret weapon – Supergirl. Once all of the super friends are assembled, they come up with a plan to attack but a shocking secret related to Flashpoint is revealed and suddenly no one is sure who they can trust. Meanwhile, Wally wants to join the battle against the aliens but Iris tells him he’s not ready.

The crossover starts on Supergirl S02E08 Medusa (I). It continues on Arrow S05E08 Invasion! (III) and DC's Legends of Tomorrow S02E07 Invasion! (IV).

Episodes.Title: The Present
Episodes.Description: With Alchemy and Savitar still looming threats, Barry is unable to focus on the Christmas holiday, and especially his relationship with Iris. Determined to stop Savitar, Barry goes to Earth-3 to get advice from Jay Garrick. Wally wants to help Barry fight Savitar and reveals that he’s been training with H.R, which doesn’t go over well with Barry. As Cisco faces his first Christmas without his brother Dante, old wounds are reopened.

Episodes.Title: Borrowing Problems from the Future
Episodes.Description: Barry is tormented by his vision of the future where Iris is murdered by Savitar. When a criminal named Plunder shows up in Central City, Barry recalls the villain’s presence in his vision of the future and fears that if he catches Plunder, it will cement Iris’ fate. Confused about Barry’s hesitation to stop Plunder, Wally decides to step in as Kid Flash. Caitlin offers Julian a job.

Episodes.Title: Dead or Alive
Episodes.Description: H.R.'s past catches up with him when a bounty hunter with vibe powers named Gypsy arrives in Central City to bring him back to Earth-19 to stand trial for his crime. It turns out inter-dimensional travel is illegal on their Earth. H.R. surrenders but when Barry and Cisco find out that H.R.’s only hope would be to challenge Gypsy to a fight to the death, they intercede and Cisco offers to fight Gypsy instead.

Episodes.Title: Untouchable
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team at S.T.A.R. Labs work together to bring down Clive Yorkin, a criminal meta-human who is methodically killing people by causing them to decompose at an accelerated rate. Joe becomes his next target but it’s Iris who is caught in the crossfire. The Flash mentors Kid Flash and begins to elevate the newer speedster’s training to another level.

Episodes.Title: Attack on Gorilla City (1)
Episodes.Description: When Jesse Quick informs the team that her father has been abducted, Barry, Caitlin, Cisco and Julian voyage to Earth-2 on a rescue mission to save Harry from Gorilla City. As they trek through the forest, Barry and the team are immediately captured and brought to Grodd. Grodd tells them he needs their help to stop Solovar, the leader of Gorilla City, as Solovar wants to invade Earth-1. Meanwhile, back on Earth-1, Jesse and Kid Flash hit the streets to stop a metahuman that can control gravity, with H.R. and Joe guiding them from S.T.A.R. Labs.

Episodes.Title: Attack on Central City (2)
Episodes.Description: When Grodd and his army of gorillas bring the battle to Earth-1, The Flash and team must find a way to stop them before they destroy Central City. Gypsy returns to join the fight. Meanwhile, Jesse Quick decides she wants to stay with Wally on Earth-1.

Episodes.Title: The Wrath of Savitar
Episodes.Description: While training with Barry, Wally starts to have visions of Savitar, which he hides from the team. A dangerous secret threatens Barry and Iris’ happiness.

Episodes.Title: Into the Speed Force
Episodes.Description: Desperate to stop Savitar and save his friends, Barry turns to the Speed Force for answers.  H.R. gives Jesse some advice.

Episodes.Title: Duet (II)
Episodes.Description:
Barry and team are surprised when Mon-El and Hank Henshaw arrive on their Earth carrying a comatose Supergirl who was whammied by the Music Meister. Unable to wake her up, they turn to Team Flash to save her. However, the Music Meister surprises The Flash and puts him in a similar coma, one that Team Flash can't cure. Kara and Barry wake up without their powers in an alternate reality where life is like a musical and the only way to escape is by following the script, complete with singing and dancing, to the end.

The crossover starts on Supergirl S02E16 Star-Crossed (I).

Episodes.Title: Abra Kadabra
Episodes.Description: The Flash fights a villain from Earth-19 called Abra Kadabra, who offers to reveal Savitar's identity in exchange for his release.

Episodes.Title: The Once and Future Flash
Episodes.Description: Barry travels to the future to find out Savitar’s still unknown identity in the hopes of saving Iris.  Upon his arrival in 2024, Barry encounters future versions of his Team Flash friends, who, following the death of Iris, have become very different people, profoundly impacted by their showdown with Savitar.  It will be up to Barry to infuse a sense of hope back into the team, as he proves to be hero his future friends have been waiting for. Meanwhile, back in 2017, the hunt for Killer Frost continues.

Episodes.Title: I Know Who You Are
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team meet Tracy Brand, a scientist, who may be the key to stopping Savitar. Unfortunately, Killer Frost is also after Tracy so Team Flash must battle their old friend, which proves to be particularly difficult for Cisco. Joe and Cecile’s relationship takes a big turn.

Episodes.Title: Cause and Effect
Episodes.Description: Barry takes drastic measures to stop Savitar. Meanwhile, H.R. continues to push Tracy Brand to design the trap for Savitar and Killer Frost returns with an interesting proposal.

Episodes.Title: Infantino Street
Episodes.Description: With only 24 hours left until Savitar murders Iris, Barry struggles to save the woman he loves and makes the choice to use any means necessary to do so. Realizing he has one option left to save her, The Flash turns to Captain Cold for help.

Episodes.Title: Finish Line
Episodes.Description: With nothing left to lose, Barry takes on Savitar.

Episodes.Title: The Flash Reborn
Episodes.Description: With Barry in the speed force, Iris, Kid Flash, Joe and Vibe have taken over protecting Central City. However, when a powerful armored villain threatens to level the city if The Flash doesn't appear, Cisco makes a risky decision to break Barry out of the speed force. However, the Barry that comes out isn't the same Barry that went in.

Episodes.Title: Mixed Signals
Episodes.Description: Barry has his hands full when he takes on a dangerous meta who can control technology, while also confronting an obstacle in his personal life: the ramifications of abandoning Iris for six months to balance the Speed Force. Meanwhile, Gypsy breaches in for a hot date with Cisco, but she gets annoyed when his work keeps them apart.

Episodes.Title: Luck Be a Lady
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team are hit by a string of bad luck and realize it is the handiwork of a new meta, Becky nicknamed Hazard, who has the ability to give others bad luck, while cashing in the benefits for herself. Meanwhile, Harry Wells returns to Earth-1 to give Wally a message from Jesse.

Episodes.Title: Elongated Journey Into Night
Episodes.Description: Cisco is shocked when Gypsy's father, Breacher, shows up on Earth-1. Breacher takes an immediate disliking to Cisco and decides to hunt him. Meanwhile, Barry runs into his old nemesis, Ralph Dibny.

Episodes.Title: Girls Night Out
Episodes.Description: Having received an ominous threat from her old boss, Amunet, Caitlin fears that her past time as Killer Frost may be back to haunt her. Felicity comes to Central City to help the girls celebrate Iris's bachelorette party, while Cisco, Joe and the guys take Barry out for a night on the town.

Episodes.Title: When Harry Met Harry...
Episodes.Description: When collectors of Native American artifacts are attacked by a meta named Mina Chayton who can bring inanimate objects to life, Barry turns to a surprising ally for help. Determined to crack the identity of The Thinker, Harry enlists Cisco's help to summon the ultimate think tank: "The Council of Wells'," a roundtable of the brightest Harrison Wells' from various Earths.

Episodes.Title: Therefore I Am
Episodes.Description: Barry comes face to face with DeVoe. Devoe's past is revealed through flashbacks. Meanwhile, Iris puts the final touches on the wedding, which is a week away.

Episodes.Title: Crisis on Earth-X (III)
Episodes.Description:
Barry and Iris's wedding brings the gang together, but things go awry when villains from Earth-X attack the ceremony. All of the superheroes band together with help from their super friends like Citizen Cold, The Ray, Felicity Smoak, Iris West and Alex Danvers to take on their most formidable villains yet. Earth's mightiest heroes - Green Arrow, Supergirl, The Flash and White Canary - lead their teams into battle to save the world.

The crossover starts on Supergirl S03E08 Crisis on Earth X (I) and Arrow S06E08 Crisis on Earth X (II). It continues on DC's Legends of Tomorrow S03E08 Crisis on Earth X (IV).

Episodes.Title: Don't Run
Episodes.Description: Amunet kidnaps Caitlin and puts meta-dampener handcuffs on her to keep her from turning into Killer Frost. Amunet tells Caitlin she needs her to perform a tricky medical task and if Caitlin fails, Amunet will kill her. Meanwhile, The Thinker traps The Flash in a speedster-proof prison. With the clock ticking, The Team doesn't have the time or resources to track both Caitlin and Barry so Iris is forced to choose who to save.

Episodes.Title: The Trial of The Flash
Episodes.Description: As Barry’s trial for the murder of Clifford DeVoe begins, Iris and Joe must decide how far they are willing to go to keep Barry out of prison.

Episodes.Title: The Elongated Knight Rises
Episodes.Description: When a familiar villain returns to terrorize Central City, Ralph must rise up to defend the innocent while Barry is detained by his trial. Meanwhile, Barry searches for the strength to keep his optimism alive in the face of his new circumstances.

Episodes.Title: Honey, I Shrunk Team Flash
Episodes.Description: A meta who can shrink anything he touches battles Team Flash. Cisco and Ralph get caught in his crossfire and are shrunk to miniature versions of themselves. Cecile realizes her pregnancy has caused her to have temporary powers and discovers she can hear other people’s thoughts, which unnerves Joe. Meanwhile, Barry meets someone with a mysterious connection to Henry Allen.

Episodes.Title: True Colors
Episodes.Description: After hearing that Amunet has struck a deal to buy all of the metahumans in Iron Heights, Barry must decide if he should expose his powers in order to save his cellmates. After a visit from an old friend, Ralph is reminded of his shady past and wonders if he’s really a changed man.

Episodes.Title: Subject 9
Episodes.Description: Barry meets a powerful woman whose abilities could help him in his battle with DeVoe. Meanwhile, after learning that DeVoe is targeting everyone who was on the bus, Ralph decides he doesn't want to be a hero anymore, his only concern is staying alive. Harry offers to help Joe.

Episodes.Title: Enter Flashtime
Episodes.Description: When a nuclear bomb detonates in downtown Central City, Barry, Jesse Quick and Jay Garrick slow down time by entering Flashtime. As everyone in the city is frozen, the three speedsters push themselves to the breaking point to save the city and everyone in it.

Episodes.Title: Run, Iris, Run
Episodes.Description: Team Flash confront a new bus meta, Matthew aka Melting Pot. He has the ability to swap people’s DNA, so during a battle with Team Flash, he transfers Barry’s super speed to Iris. Now, with a new threat unleashed on Central City, Barry must act as the team leader while Iris takes on the mantle of superhero speedster in order to defeat their new foe.

Episodes.Title: Null and Annoyed
Episodes.Description: Barry and Ralph take different approaches to finding the remaining bus metas before DeVoe gets to them. However, Ralph's cavalier attitude frustrates Barry and the two clash over what it means to be a hero. Meanwhile, Breacher returns to ask Cisco for a favor.

Episodes.Title: Lose Yourself
Episodes.Description: When Barry and Team Flash find a way to enter The Thinker’s lair, Ralph considers crossing a dangerous line to defeat DeVoe. Meanwhile, Joe is concerned by Harry’s recent behavior.

Episodes.Title: Fury Rogue
Episodes.Description: When Barry needs help transporting a dangerous meta, he calls on a new friend for help - Leo Snart AKA Citizen Cold. Meanwhile, Cisco becomes suspicious of Harry.

Episodes.Title: Therefore She Is
Episodes.Description: Barry and Team Flash team up with Gypsy to try to thwart Thinker's plan. Meanwhile, Cisco and Gypsy have a heart to heart talk about their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Harry and the Harrisons
Episodes.Description: With DeVoe's Enlightenment device nearly complete, in order to disable it The Flash and his team must put their faith in an unlikely ally – Amunet Black.
