Episodes.Description: Peter and Mary Jane get engaged. The happy couple goes to ask Dr. Connors if he'll give away the bride, not knowing that he's been fighting against the return of the Lizard. While they are talking to him, three more humanoid lizards attack and kidnap Dr. Connors. With the Lizard taking over and Spider-Man captured, Margaret Connors, Mary Jane Watson, and Debra Whitman will have to save the day.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Prowler
Episodes.Description: Upon returning to his new apartment, Peter is confronted by the Prowler. Revealing himself to be Hobie Brown, he tells Peter that he knows about Peter's connection to Spiderman, and that somehow the Kingpin is involved in all this.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding
Episodes.Description: Peter and Mary Jane's big day arrives, but things aren't going to go to plan if Harry Osborn gets his way. With guests including Flash Thompson, Liz, Aunt May, Anna Watson, Felicia Hardy, J. Jonah Jameson, Robbie Robertson and Wilson Fisk, along with gate crashers including the Green Goblin, the Kingpin, Alistair Smythe, the Scorpion, the Black Cat, Herbert Landon, the Mega-Slayer, Norman Osborn, and an army of robot Goblin Warriors, it'll certainly be a day to remember.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (1)
Episodes.Description: After a visit from an "old friend" of the family, Peter travels to Russia to investigate the mystery of his parents disappearance, and runs into some old friends.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (2): Unclaimed Legacy
Episodes.Description: Still in Russia, Peter discovers that searching for clues to his family's past isn't easy when he has to battle the Insidious Six and the Red Skull.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (3): Secrets of the Six
Episodes.Description: Robbie and Peter encounter an old professor who knows about the Six Forgotten Warriors.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (4): The Six Fight Again
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and the Warriors join forces to stop the Kingpin from activating the doomsday device.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (5): The Price of Heroism
Episodes.Description: Red Skull reveals his Doomsday Weapon, the powerful Electro.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Hydro-Man (1)
Episodes.Description: Mary Jane and Peter arrive in Niagara Falls for their postponed honeymoon, but it is soon interrupted when Hydro-Man returns and kidnaps Mary Jane.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Hydro-Man (2)
Episodes.Description: Peter is shocked by Mary Jane's new powers, so they seek Curt Connors' help in figuring everything out. Mary Jane tells them about a dream she's been having, which may be a clue to her disappearance. But Hydro-Man finds them and kidnaps her again.

Episodes.Title: Secret Wars (1): Arrival
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is transported to an alien world, where he meets the Beyonder, a being who wants to see if good is stronger than evil. He then summons a group of the greatest villains from Earth to this world, telling Spider-Man to put together a group of heroes to fight them and save the planet.

Episodes.Title: Secret Wars (2): The Gauntlet of the Red Skull
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man summons the Black Cat from Earth, who despite her anger at being kidnapped, decides to help him fight the villains on the alien planet. The heroes must defeat the Red Skull, Doctor Octopus, and Alistair Smythe's robots while protecting a group of rebels, who are trying to take their planet back.

Episodes.Title: Secret Wars (3): Doom
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom reverts the Thing to his human form and holds the other heroes prisoner. In an attempt to free his friends, the Thing tells Dr. Doom about the Beyonder. Dr. Doom then steals the Beyonder's powers, but they begin manifesting themselves in the form of creatures from Dr. Doom's dreams.

Episodes.Title: Spider Wars (1): I Really, Really Hate Clones
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man finds himself in yet another dimension, where he meets himself.

Episodes.Title: Spider Wars (2): Farewell, Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is sent through several dimensions trying to fix time and seal away Spider-Carnage. Peter meets his would-be girlfriend Gwen Stacy and Stan Lee.

Entries.Title: Marvel's Inhumans
Entries.Description: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

Episodes.Title: Behold...The Inhumans
Episodes.Description: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

Episodes.Title: Those Who Would Destroy Us
Episodes.Description: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

Episodes.Title: Divide and Conquer
Episodes.Description: After fleeing their home, The Inhumans desperately search for each other in the wake of Maximus’ coup. Now they must learn who they can trust on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Make Way For... Medusa
Episodes.Description: The search for Black Bolt continues on Earth; meanwhile, Maximus makes bold moves to cement his status as the new ruler of Attilan.

Episodes.Title: Something Inhuman This Way Comes...
Episodes.Description: On the run from Auran’s forces, Black Bolt and Medusa reluctantly work with Louise to help locate the rest of their family. Back on Attilan, Maximus’ actions change the game completely.

Episodes.Title: The Gentleman's Name is Gorgon
Episodes.Description: Gorgon and Karnak take on Auran and her Inhuman army with disastrous results.

Episodes.Title: Havoc in the Hidden Land
Episodes.Description: The Royal Family returns to Attilan and comes face to face with Maximus.

Episodes.Title: ...And Finally: Black Bolt
Episodes.Description: It’s brother versus brother as the final showdown between Black Bolt and Maximus takes an unexpected turn – one with lasting consequences for all of Inhumanity.

Entries.Title: Record of Ragnarok
Entries.Description: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brünnhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

Episodes.Title: Ragnarok
Episodes.Description: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brünnhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

Episodes.Title: Worthy Opponent
Episodes.Description: In the first round of the Ragnarok battle, Han dynasty warlord Lü Bu puts up a good fight against Norse god Thor, surprising the gods in attendance.

Episodes.Title: Killer Move
Episodes.Description: To give Lü Bu the upper hand against Thor, Brünnhilde summons her sister Randgriz and asks her to transform into a sacred weapon — the Shield Breaker.

Episodes.Title: Joy
Episodes.Description: Lü Bu’s legs are crushed by the mighty Geirröd Thor's Hammer attack, but just when all hope seems lost, the warlord’s trusty horse Red Hare rides in.

Episodes.Title: FILE No.00000000001
Episodes.Description: Chosen for the next round is the father of humankind and the man bearing more hatred towards the gods than anyone else: Adam himself.

Episodes.Title: Great Emulation
Episodes.Description: Zeus insists on going up against Adam, who joins forces with Valkyrie Reginleif to obtain a most peculiar weapon: a knuckleduster.

Episodes.Title: Expelled from Paradise
Episodes.Description: Just when it looks like Adam will earn humankind the victory they long for, Zeus gathers his strength to ask Adam why he's really fighting.

Episodes.Title: Grace Abounding
Episodes.Description: Zeus has transformed into his final most powerful form, but after the beating he's suffered, he may not last much longer in the fight.

Episodes.Title: Tyrant of the Ocean
Episodes.Description: Humankind is desperate to win the next bout, but the god they're going up against is one of the mightiest of them all: Poseidon

Episodes.Title: Greatest Loser
Episodes.Description: Kojiro Sasaki uses his mighty Tsubame Gaeshi move to finish off Poseidon, but the god of the sea won't be sunk so easily.

Episodes.Title: The Swallow Gazes into the Abyss
Episodes.Description: Through the power of Valkyrie Hrist, Kojiro's broken blade is transformed into dual swords, allowing him to tap into the depths of his inner strength.

Episodes.Title: And Ragnarok Goes On
Episodes.Description: Despite Kojiro's Niten Ganryu duel blade method, Poseidon's powerful attacks continue to wear him down. But the battle isn't over yet.

Episodes.Title: Good vs. Evil
Episodes.Description: The gods have no intention of letting the humans win the next round; for their next fighter, they present none other than the great hero, Hercules.

Episodes.Title: The Indomitable War God
Episodes.Description: The spectators notice that the tattoos on Hercules have grown significantly — and if they continue to grow, the hero will suffer a painful death.

Episodes.Title: Birth of a Monster
Episodes.Description: In late 19th century London, the young son of a prostitute has a special ability that helps him survive the poverty he was born into.

Episodes.Title: The Final Labor
Episodes.Description: Although he’s lost his left arm, Hercules remains steadfast, easily summoning the strength to unleash his ultimate move: the Twelfth Labor.

Episodes.Title: Requiem
Episodes.Description: The brutal fourth round has pushed both fighters beyond their breaking point; when the winner is finally announced, there is no joy or celebration.

Episodes.Title: Conflicting Motives
Episodes.Description: To capitalize on humanity's momentum, Brünnhilde pays a visit to the colossal Tameemon Raiden, the most powerful sumo wrestler in history.

Episodes.Title: Hundred Seals
Episodes.Description: Stepping into the sumo ring to take on Tameemon Raiden is the God of Destruction, the Destroyer himself: Supreme Lord Shiva.

Episodes.Title: The Pinnacle of 1116
Episodes.Description: Years ago, Shiva spent many happy days with his best friend Rudra. Then one day, Rudra asks Shiva to join him on a journey to the top.

Episodes.Title: Resonance
Episodes.Description: As a child, Raiden had to suppress his full strength so he wouldn’t hurt other people. But now, to win this battle, he’s not holding anything back.

Episodes.Title: The Brink
Episodes.Description: The match comes to a moving end. Even Zeus is impressed by humanity's powerful spirit; but he's going to make sure the gods get the ultimate victory.

Episodes.Title: Round Six
Episodes.Description: With the scoreboard almost neck-and-neck, Buddha declares that he'll fight in the next round — but whose side will he be fighting on?

Episodes.Title: Zero
Episodes.Description: Struck by the amount of suffering humans must endure, Zerofuku decides to absorb all of their unhappiness, but it still isn't enough to end their pain.

Episodes.Title: The strongest puberty in history
Episodes.Description: There was once a prince who was born into great wealth and given the very best of everything. But one day, he decides to leave it all behind.

Episodes.Title: Legend of the Underworld
Episodes.Description: Nobody knows who the strange new creature is, but he's clearly very strong. And most worryingly, Buddha can't foresee his new opponent's next moves.

Episodes.Title: The Way of Light
Episodes.Description: It looks like the match is over. But then Buddha gets up, looking stronger than ever. Will he be able to gain another crucial point for the humans?

Entries.Title: Batman: The Brave and the Bold
Entries.Description: Batman and the Blue Beetle attempt to stop an asteroid but end up on a distant planet fighting Kanjar Ro.

Episodes.Title: Rise of the Blue Beetle!
Episodes.Description: Batman and the Blue Beetle attempt to stop an asteroid but end up on a distant planet fighting Kanjar Ro.

Episodes.Title: Terror on Dinosaur Island!
Episodes.Description: When Gorilla Grodd creates a machine that will turn humans into primates, it's up to Batman and Plastic Man to save the day.

Episodes.Title: Evil Under the Sea!
Episodes.Description: Batman investigates seismic activity and pays a visit to Aquaman, who is unaware that his brother Orm is conspiring with Black Manta to conquer Atlantis.

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Secret Santas!
Episodes.Description: After taking care of Sportsmaster with the Blue Beetle, Batman teams up with Red Tornado in order to stop the villain Fun Haus from ruining Christmas.

Episodes.Title: Day of the Dark Knight!
Episodes.Description: After teaming up with Guy Gardner, Batman travels into the past with Green Arrow to stop Morgaine Le Fay from conquering Camelot.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Outsiders!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Wildcat face off against a trio of super-powered teenagers who are attacking symbols of consumerism.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of the Dead Man!
Episodes.Description: Batman teams up with Deadman to take down Gentleman Ghost.

Episodes.Title: Fall of the Blue Beetle!
Episodes.Description: The Blue Beetle is determined to learn the fate of his predecessor, Ted Kord.

Episodes.Title: Journey to the Center of the Bat!
Episodes.Description: Atom and Aquaman shrink down and enter Batman's body in order to help him fight off a chemical infection.

Episodes.Title: The Eyes of Despero!
Episodes.Description: Batman helps Guy Gardner and the remnants of the Green Lantern Corps fight against a would-be galactic conqueror.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Fearsome Fangs!
Episodes.Description: When three of his former classmates kill their former martial arts teacher, Batman enlists the help of fellow student Bronze Tiger to stop them from stealing the powerful Wudang Totem that the elderly sensei was guarding.

Episodes.Title: Deep Cover for Batman!
Episodes.Description: The Red Hood, a hero from an alternate dimension, enlists the Dark Knight's help against the Injustice Syndicate, a team of supervillains who are doppelgangers of Batman's friends back home.

Episodes.Title: Game Over for Owlman!
Episodes.Description: After his evil counterpart from an alternate dimension undertakes a crime spree disguised as him, Batman finds help from an unexpected ally.

Episodes.Title: Mystery in Space!
Episodes.Description: A melancholy Aquaman accompanies Batman to the planet Rann, where they aid Adam Strange in his fight against the Gordanians.

Episodes.Title: Trials of the Demon!
Episodes.Description: Magically transported to 19th century London, Batman aids Etrigan the Demon and Sherlock Holmes in battling Gentleman Jim Craddock, the future Gentleman Ghost.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Huntress!
Episodes.Description: While on the trail of mobsters Babyface and Mrs. Manface, Blue Beetle develops a crush on the sultry Huntress.

Episodes.Title: Menace of the Conqueror Caveman!
Episodes.Description: Batman gets the unwelcome aid of the profit-seeking Booster Gold in his efforts to stop Kru'll the Eternal.

Episodes.Title: The Color of Revenge!
Episodes.Description: Crazy Quilt is blinded by a young Robin. Years later, he comes to Blüdhaven looking for revenge.

Episodes.Title: Legends of the Dark Mite!
Episodes.Description: Batman finds himself idolized by a powerful being from the fifth dimension.

Episodes.Title: Hail the Tornado Tyrant!
Episodes.Description: The robotic superhero Red Tornado builds a "son" named Tornado Champion, but Batman's concerns are realized when the new robot turns itself into a villain named Tornado Tyrant.

Episodes.Title: Duel of the Double Crossers!
Episodes.Description: Plucked from time by Mongul, Jonah Hex brings Batman to Warworld to fight in gladiatorial competitions.

Episodes.Title: The Last Bat on Earth!
Episodes.Description: Batman pursues Gorilla Grodd into the future, where he enlists Kamandi's help against Grodd and his ape army.

Episodes.Title: When OMAC Attacks!
Episodes.Description: Hawk & Dove help Batman stop an intergalactic war. Later, Batman and OMAC team up to stop an attack by Shrapnel.

Episodes.Title: Mayhem of the Music Meister!
Episodes.Description: The Music Meister uses his ability to control minds in an effort to take over the world.

Episodes.Title: Inside the Outsiders!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Green Arrow team up to retrieve a pair of statues stolen by Catwoman. Later, Batman tries to free the Outsiders from one of Psycho Pirate's machines.

Episodes.Title: The Fate of Equinox!
Episodes.Description: After a battle with Two-Face, Batman and Dr. Fate must deal with Equinox who is attempting to replace both the Lords of Order and the Lords of Chaos.

Episodes.Title: Death Race to Oblivion!
Episodes.Description: Mongul forces heroes (Batman, Green Arrow, Guy Gardner, Huntress, Plastic Man and Woozy Winks) and villains (Black Manta, Catwoman, Gentleman Ghost, Joker, and Steppenwolf) alike to race for Earth's survival.

Episodes.Title: Long Arm of the Law!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Plastic Man team up to save some scouts. Later, the two have must deal with Rubberneck and Kite Man who are targeting Plastic Man's family in a scheme for revenge.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Reach!
Episodes.Description: The Challengers of the Unknown go to the island and are exposed to Starro. Later, Blue Beetle runs into trouble on Oa when the Green Lantern Corp try to arrest him for possessing the scarab.

Episodes.Title: Aquaman's Outrageous Adventure!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Enemy Ace stop aliens interfering in the past. Later, Aquaman takes his family on vacation and must resist his desire to fight crime.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Age of Justice!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Detective Chimp work together to foil Falseface. Later, Batman and the Justice Society of America face off with Per Degaton.

Episodes.Title: Sidekicks Assemble!
Episodes.Description: Robin, Speedy, and Aqualad team up to earn respect and stop Ra's Al Ghul from attacking the world.

Episodes.Title: Clash of the Metal Men!
Episodes.Description: Aquaman falls to Starro. Meanwhile, Batman teams up with the Metal Men to defeat Chemo and, then, to save Doc Magnus from a team of powerful living gases.

Episodes.Title: A Bat Divided!
Episodes.Description: The Riddler torments Booster Gold and Batman. Later, Batman bears witness to the creation of Firestorm. Unfortunately, in the explosion, Batman is divided into three different aspects of himself.

Episodes.Title: The Super-Batman of Planet X!
Episodes.Description: Batman discovers his doppelganger on a distant planet.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Shazam!
Episodes.Description: When Captain Marvel's enemies Black Adam and Dr Sivana team up, Marvel enlists Batman to aid him.

Episodes.Title: Chill of the Night!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Zatanna make short work of Abra Kadabra. Later, Batman must choose between justice and vengeance when he confronts Joe Chill the man who murdered his parents.

Episodes.Title: Gorillas in Our Midst!
Episodes.Description: Gorilla Grodd replaces Gotham's human population with gorillas.

Episodes.Title: The Siege of Starro! (1)
Episodes.Description: Led by Faceless Hunter, the Starro Invasion comes on full swing. Only Batman and a handful of unlikely heroes remain uninfected to thwart the alien parasites and their mind-controlled hosts before all of Earth is sucked dry.

Episodes.Title: The Siege of Starro! (2)
Episodes.Description: Star Conqueror may be defeated, but Faceless Hunter is not! The alien warrior manipulates B'Wana Beast, forcing him to combine thetiny starros into one massive beast he plans to use to destroy the planet! But Batman has his own back-up - the Metal Men!

Episodes.Title: Requiem for a Scarlet Speedster!
Episodes.Description: Batman realizes that Barry Allen is not dead.

Episodes.Title: The Last Patrol!
Episodes.Description: The Doom Patrol are pulled out of retirement to battle supervillains.

Episodes.Title: Menace of the Madniks!
Episodes.Description: Booster Gold misses his late best bud, Blue Beetle, but when he travels back in time to hang with him, he throws the present into chaos.

Episodes.Title: Emperor Joker!
Episodes.Description: Fifth-dimensional fan boy Bat-Mite inadvertently gives Joker his limitless power while hoping to witness a hero-villain showdown.

Episodes.Title: The Criss Cross Conspiracy!
Episodes.Description: he long-retired Batwoman sees an opportunity for revenge against the villain who humiliated her: the Riddler.

Episodes.Title: The Plague of the Prototypes!
Episodes.Description: Black Mask reprograms Batman's Bat-Robots to do his bidding.

Episodes.Title: Cry Freedom Fighters!
Episodes.Description: Batman, Plastic Man and the Freedom Fighters try to stop an Earth invasion.

Episodes.Title: The Knights of Tomorrow!
Episodes.Description: It is the story of Batman's retirement and his marriage to Catwoman. Bruce Wayne now hopes that his son Damian will follow in his footsteps, and his confidence in him will be put to the test.

Episodes.Title: Darkseid Descending!
Episodes.Description: The threat of an impending invasion from Apokolips compels Batman, Aquaman, and Martian Manhunter to form a new Justice League.

Episodes.Title: Bat-Mite Presents: Batman's Strangest Cases!
Episodes.Description: Bat-Mite hosts a series of Batman's most bizarre adventures including the Mad Magazine-inspired Batboy and Rubin, a Japanese-influenced Bat-Manga and a guest starring role from the Scooby Gang and Weird Al Yankovic.

Episodes.Title: The Malicious Mr. Mind!
Episodes.Description: Batman joins forces with Captain Marvel, Mary Marvel, and Captain Marvel Jr. to take on Dr. Sivana and his Monster Society of Evil. However, the villains gain the most likely of newcomers -- the wormlike Mr. Mind.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Superheroes!
Episodes.Description: When Superman is affected by Red Kryptonite he becomes a super jerk. Batman must stop him from destroying his reputation and more.

Episodes.Title: Joker: The Vile and the Villainous!
Episodes.Description: The Joker teams up with the Weeper.

Episodes.Title: Shadow of the Bat!
Episodes.Description: Batman becomes infected after being bitten by a vampire.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Batmen!
Episodes.Description: Batman and Vigilante have a run in with some villains. Later Aquaman, Captain Marvel, Plastic Man, and Green Arrow try to fill in when Batmen is injured.

Episodes.Title: Scorn of the Star Sapphire!
Episodes.Description: Hal Jordan, the Green Lantern, comes to Batman for help in defeating his nemesis, the beautiful supervillain Star Sapphire.

Episodes.Title: Time Out for Vengeance!
Episodes.Description: The Creeper cheers on and helps Batman when he's fighting Hellgrammite. Then, the Justice League International travels to the past to stop the minions of Equinox from wiping out all the incarnations of Batman throughout time.

Episodes.Title: Sword of the Atom!
Episodes.Description: Searching the Amazon jungle for the missing Ray Palmer, the scientist who was at one time The Atom, Batman disappears. Now Aquaman recruits the new Atom, Ryan Choi, to help shrink him down to microscopic size...

Episodes.Title: Triumvirate of Terror!
Episodes.Description: Batman, Superman and Wonder Woman face a triple threat as they square off to do battle with Lex Luthor, Joker and Cheetah.

Episodes.Title: Bold Beginnings!
Episodes.Description: After a team up with Space Ghost and his companions, Batman must come to the aid of three of his fellow superheroes who have fallen into the icy clutches of Mr. Freeze.

Episodes.Title: Powerless!
Episodes.Description: Captain Atom joins the Justice League, but has to learn how to continue being a super hero even after losing his powers to his old enemy Major Force.

Episodes.Title: Crisis: 22,300 Miles Above Earth!
Episodes.Description: While the Justice Society is visiting the Justice League for the first time, Batman is in Asia infiltrating a secret fortress where Ra's Al Ghul is plotting a new scheme for world domination.

Episodes.Title: Four Star Spectacular!
Episodes.Description: Batman teams up with DC characters Adam Strange, the Flash, 'Mazing Man and the Creature Commandos in four separate teaser vignettes.

Episodes.Title: Mitefall!
Episodes.Description: Bat-Mite tries to make the show so horrible it has to be cancelled.

Entries.Title: X-Men '97
Entries.Description: Cyclops races to find the source of new anti-mutant technology.

Episodes.Title: To Me, My X-Men
Episodes.Description: Cyclops races to find the source of new anti-mutant technology.

Episodes.Title: Mutant Liberation Begins
Episodes.Description: When Magneto is forced by the UN to stand trial, a group of anti-mutant rioters test his resolve.

Episodes.Title: Fire Made Flesh
Episodes.Description: The team is propelled into a tragic confrontation with an immortal mad scientist.

Episodes.Title: Motendo /  Lifedeath (1)
Episodes.Description: Jubilee must relive the X-Men's greatest adventures when she's transported into a 16-bit video game.

Episodes.Title: Remember It
Episodes.Description: Team members hit Genosha as UN honorees while a press event risks exposing the team's dirty laundry.

Episodes.Title: Lifedeath (2)
Episodes.Description: Storm is forced to face her worst fears in order to free herself.

Episodes.Title: Bright Eyes
Episodes.Description: The X-Men finds Sentinel inventor Bolivar Trask, realizing they've been played by a mastermind.

Episodes.Title: Tolerance Is Extinction (1)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men must unite to face a new threat.

Episodes.Title: Tolerance Is Extinction (2)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men work to settle the score before it is too late.

Episodes.Title: Tolerance Is Extinction (3)
Episodes.Description: The X-Men's dream is put to the test as mutant-human relations reach a tipping point.

Entries.Title: Iron Man: Extremis
Entries.Description: A new era dawns for Tony Stark, aka Iron Man, redefining the armored Avenger's world for the 21st century! What is Extremis, who has unleashed it, and what does its emergence portend for the world?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A new era dawns for Tony Stark, aka Iron Man, redefining the armored Avenger's world for the 21st century! What is Extremis, who has unleashed it, and what does its emergence portend for the world?

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Someone close to Tony Stark is responsible for the greatest threat to the world, an abomination of technology that has been unleashed on the world. What's worse -- it is more powerful than even Iron Man can handle!

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Powered by the Extremis serum Iron Man's deadliest foe, Malin, has been unleashed upon mankind in the form of a biologically enhanced terrorist - and now it's time for Iron Man to face the enemy...a fight he will most likely lose!

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The end for Iron Man? After a brutal fight with Extremis, Iron Man's armor is destroyed, a city is in ruins, and Tony Stark lies at death's door. Only one option remains for Stark, but will it mean losing his humanity?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Tony Stark's life is on the line as the Extremis dose he's taken rewrites his genetic code. Now Tony Stark relives his first faltering steps as Iron Man. When all is said and done, a genuinely new Armored Avenger will emerge!

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As the new Iron Man battles the foe who nearly killed him, the Extremis serum takes its toll. Who exactly is behind the Extremis leak? The answer will shock you as Iron Man enters the 21st century, forever changed!

Entries.Title: The Flash
Entries.Description: When his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, Barry Allen becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned and there are no Super Heroes to turn to. In order to save the world that he is in and return to the future that he knows, Barry's only hope is to race for his life. But will making the ultimate sacrifice be enough to reset the universe?

Entries.Title: The Flash: Saga of the Scarlet Speedster
Entries.Description: Short documentary about The Flash from comic book creation to film and television hero.

Entries.Title: Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox
Entries.Description: The Flash finds himself in a war-torn alternate timeline and teams up with alternate versions of his fellow heroes to restore the timeline.

Entries.Title: Inhumans: The First Chapter
Entries.Description: An isolated community of superhumans fight to protect themselves.

Entries.Title: Inhumans
Entries.Description: The Inhumans have always been one of Marvel’s most enduring oddities. A race of genetic freaks, they live secluded in their island kingdom of Attilan, preferring not to mix with the outside world. Even stranger, their genetic mutations are self-endowed; each Inhuman, as a coming-of-age ritual, endures exposure to the Terrigan Mists, a strange substance that imparts unearthly powers, some extraordinary, some monstrous. But now the kingdom of Attilan is under attack from without and within. Can the Royal Family, led by Black Bolt (who cannot speak for his voice carries the destructive power of an atom bomb) repel the foreign invaders who blast at their outer defense, as well as the internal threat of Black Bolt's brother, Maximus the Mad?

Entries.Title: Doctor Strange
Entries.Description: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

Entries.Title: Doctor Strange
Entries.Description: Dr. Stephen Strange embarks on a wondrous journey to the heights of a Tibetan mountain, where he seeks healing at the feet of the mysterious Ancient One.

Entries.Title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Entries.Description: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.

Entries.Title: Doctor Strange: The Score-Cerer Supreme
Entries.Description: A discussion of Michael Giacchino's work on the film and the themes the music conveys and supports for the film.

Entries.Title: Doctor Strange: The Fabric of Reality
Entries.Description: A detailed examination of the film's costumes: construction, functionality, and staying true to the characters. It also covers set design and construction, shooting in key locations, the film's scope, filming locations, and more.

Entries.Title: Dr. Strange
Entries.Description: A psychiatrist becomes the new Sorcerer Supreme of the Earth in order to battle an evil Sorceress from the past.

Entries.Title: The Avengers
Entries.Description: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

Entries.Title: Avengers: Infinity War
Entries.Description: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

Entries.Title: Avengers: Endgame
Entries.Description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

Entries.Title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
Entries.Description: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

Entries.Title: Avengers Confidential: Black Widow & Punisher
Entries.Description: When the Punisher takes out a black-market weapons dealer, he stumbles upon a far-reaching terrorist plot devised by a group known as Leviathan.

Entries.Title: Next Avengers: Heroes of Tomorrow
Entries.Description: The children of the Avengers hone their powers and go head to head with the very enemy responsible for their parents' demise.

Entries.Title: Avengers Assemble: Thor
Entries.Description: All new adventures from Earth's greatest superheroes!  It's time to celebrate the best of the best, the Avengers Heroes that have saved the Earth from mortal danger (more times than we can count). The Most Worthy of all of the Avengers, Thor encompasses the most honourable traits of a hero and a god. But balancing the responsibilites of the Asgard throne and that of an Avenger is no easy task.

Entries.Title: Avengers Assemble: Captain America
Entries.Description: It's time to celebrate the best of the best, the Avengers Heroes that have saved the Earth from mortal danger (more times than we can count). Known as the Super Soldier, Captain America lives up to his name. From infiltrating the enemy in disguise to being the last one standing in a fight, Steve Rogers is the epitome of a hero.

Entries.Title: Iron Man
Entries.Description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

Entries.Title: Iron Man 2
Entries.Description: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

Entries.Title: Iron Man 3
Entries.Description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

Entries.Title: Iron Man: Rise of Technovore
Entries.Description: Iron Man enlists the help of ruthless vigilante the Punisher to track down War Machine's murderer. All the while, he's being pursued by S.H.I.E.L.D. agents Black Widow and Hawkeye, who suspect his involvement in a recent terrorist plot.

Entries.Title: X-Men: Apocalypse
Entries.Description: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

Entries.Title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
Entries.Description: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

Entries.Title: X-Men
Entries.Description: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the X-Men, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.

Entries.Title: X-Men: First Class 35mm Special
Entries.Description: TV special about the making of "X-Men: First Class".

Entries.Title: X-Men: The Legend of Wolverine
Entries.Description: The most popular Super Hero Team in history is ready for action in a spectacular series of thrilling adventures. When a familiar face from Wolverine's former life resurfaces, he must wage a war he never intended. Ultimately, the X-Men must join forces with Magneto in a fight to save all mutants from annihilation.  Discover the truth of Wolverine's secret past, and watch his decisive battle as he is forced to make a choice that will forever affect the fate of the X-Men.

Entries.Title: Chris Claremont's X-Men
Entries.Description: Chris Claremont’s X-Men takes an in-depth look at Claremont’s monumental run. Using high-profile interviews, the film explores the behind-the-scenes development of notable characters like Wolverine, Storm, and Phoenix, as well as the challenges of creating art within a corporate system.

Entries.Title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
Entries.Description: After seeking to live a normal life, Logan sets out to avenge the death of his girlfriend by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

Entries.Title: Psycho-Pass: Sinners of the System - Case.2 First Guardian
Entries.Description: 2112; the summer before Akane Tsunemori was assigned to Division One of the Public Safety Bureau's Criminal Investigation Department. Teppei Sugo, an accomplished pilot of the Defense Army's 15th Integrated Task Force, joins the military operation in Okinawa. Three months later, an unmanned combat drone opens fire on the Ministry of Defense in Tokyo. Enforcer Tomomi Masaoka of CID Division One is dispatched to Sugo's military base to investigate the truth behind this case.

Entries.Title: Batman
Entries.Description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman known as 'The Joker' seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale.

Entries.Title: Batman Ninja vs. Yakuza League
Entries.Description: The Batman family has returned to the present to discover that Japan has disappeared, and a giant island - Hinomoto - is now in the sky over Gotham City.  At the top sit the Yakuza, a group of superpowered individuals who reign without honor or humanity and look suspiciously like the Justice League. Now, it’s up to Batman and his allies to save Gotham!

Entries.Title: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires
Entries.Description: In the time of the Aztec empire, tragedy strikes Yohualli Coatl when his father is murdered by Spanish conquistadors. To warn King Moctezuma and his high priest, Yoka, of imminent danger, Yohualli escapes to Tenochtitlán. There, he trains in the temple of the bat god Tzinacan with his mentor, developing equipment and weaponry to confront the Spanish invasion and avenge his father’s death. Along the way, he encounters key figures like the fierce Jaguar Woman and the conquistador Hernán Cortés.

Entries.Title: The Batman
Entries.Description: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

Entries.Title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
Entries.Description: Fearing the actions of a god-like Super Hero left unchecked, Gotham City’s own formidable, forceful vigilante takes on Metropolis’s most revered, modern-day savior, while the world wrestles with what sort of hero it really needs. And with Batman and Superman at war with one another, a new threat quickly arises, putting mankind in greater danger than it’s ever known before.

Entries.Title: Ragnarok
Entries.Description: Hillevi, a young viking warrior, faces Jörmungand, the World-Serpent.

Entries.Title: Ragnarok
Entries.Description: Three exciting stories of science fiction adventure set many years in the future. The Earth, once the hub of the Galaxy and its judicial system, is now wasteland. This and its survivors are all that is left of a bygone age after the most vicious intergalactic war ever seen. The Earth's colonies are devoid of any law enforcement system. It is the survival of the fittest (or meanest). The only law left is Ragnarok, a hard-hitting enforcer and his alien friend Smith, who travel the Universe in an attempt to see fair play.

Entries.Title: Ragnarok
Entries.Description: Archaeologist Sigurd Svendsen discovers that the Oseberg ship hides a secret from the Viking Age. Along with his two children put Sigurd out on a quest to find the truth. The mystery leads them into "No Man's Land" between Norway and Russia where no man traveling in modern times. Old runes take on new meaning when the secret they uncover is more frightening than anyone could have imagined.

Entries.Title: Thor: Ragnarok
Entries.Description: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

Entries.Title: Superman
Entries.Description: Mild-mannered Clark Kent works as a reporter at the Daily Planet alongside his crush, Lois Lane. Clark must summon his superhero alter-ego when the nefarious Lex Luthor launches a plan to take over the world.

Entries.Title: Superman
Entries.Description: After The Daily Planet receives a letter from a mad scientist threatening to wreak destruction with his Electrothanasia Ray, Lois Lane heads out in the hopes of getting more information for a news story.

Entries.Title: Superman
Entries.Description: Superman comes to Earth as a child and grows up to be his home's first superhero with his first major challenge being to oppose The Spider Lady.

Entries.Title: Superman
Entries.Description: A scientist, whose daughter had died at the hands of a gangster, creates a serum that will give a person superhuman powers. His adopted daughter uses the serum to battle a gang that threatens to take over the city.

Entries.Title: Locke the Superman: New World Command
Entries.Description: Azalea has been residing on the Colony-Planet of Dinahl, and she can't recall anything about herself until she hears a voice calling her name. Then there is another voice summoning her to go to a park on top of a skyscraper. Once she arrives there, she meets up with other people who also have no recollection of who they are or what they were doing before arriving at this destination as instructed by the voice. All the people assembled there possess superhuman powers, such as Eno's psychic power, Umoth's x-ray vision, Neia's teleportation powers, Azalea's telepathy, and Locke's electrical wizardry. Who has summoned them, and what will the five super-psychics confront?

Entries.Title: Spider-Man
Entries.Description: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man
Entries.Description: When an extortionist threatens to force a multi-suicide unless a huge ransom is paid, only Peter Parker can stop him with his new powers as Spider-Man.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Spider-man must rescue the beautiful daughter of the evil Dr. Lightning.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
Entries.Description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
Entries.Description: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse’s very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he loves most.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
Entries.Description: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
Entries.Description: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

Entries.Title: The Amazing Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Peter Parker is an outcast high schooler abandoned by his parents as a boy, leaving him to be raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Like most teenagers, Peter is trying to figure out who he is and how he got to be the person he is today. As Peter discovers a mysterious briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to understand his parents' disappearance – leading him directly to Oscorp and the lab of Dr. Curt Connors, his father's former partner. As Spider-Man is set on a collision course with Connors' alter ego, The Lizard, Peter will make life-altering choices to use his powers and shape his destiny to become a hero.

Entries.Title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
Entries.Description: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
Entries.Description: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.

Entries.Title: DC Showcase: Green Arrow
Entries.Description: At an airport, the Emerald Archer must protect a young princess from assassins.
